gear-armour#0147.dst: Doğrudan toprağa ve onun yönlerine bir saygı duruşu olarak dövülen bu süslü işlemeli çizmeler, yalnızca Kovanın Hanımı'nı alt edenlere verilir.
gear-armour#0147.flat: Forged in direct tribute to the earth and its aspects, these ornately-crafted boots are given only to those who have bested the Mistress of the Hive.

gear-armour#0148.src: True to their promise, these goggles were left as a memento for Ohms when his lover Gale finally died. Light as air, Gale's carefree nature lends itself to those who don them.
gear-armour#0148.dst: Sözlerine sadık kalınarak bu gözlükler, sevgilisi Gale sonunda öldüğünde Ohms'a bir hatıra olarak bırakıldı. Hava kadar hafif olan Gale'in kaygısız doğası, onları takanlara geçer.
gear-armour#0148.flat: True to their promise, these goggles were left as a memento for Ohms when his lover Gale finally died. Light as air, Gale's carefree nature lends itself to those who don them.

gear-armour#0149.src: Forged with the raw powers of both the earth and the sea, these boots were initially an attempt at creating a method of foot-travel over the seas. Despite the spectacular failure of that application, they remain a formidable and reliable set of armor.
gear-armour#0149.dst: Hem toprağın hem de denizin ham güçleriyle dövülen bu çizmeler, aslında denizler üzerinde yürüyerek seyahat etmenin bir yolunu bulma denemesiydi. Bu kullanım muhteşem bir başarısızlıkla sonuçlansa da çizmeler hâlâ zorlu ve güvenilir bir zırh olarak kalıyor.
gear-armour#0149.flat: Forged with the raw powers of both the earth and the sea, these boots were initially an attempt at creating a method of foot-travel over the seas. Despite the spectacular failure of that application, they remain a formidable and reliable set of armor.

gear-armour#0150.src: Those who believe in chances are the most foolish - every step forward is a step closer to demise. Greed blinds their eyes, as it guides their souls to eternal despair.
gear-armour#0150.dst: Şansa inananlar en aptallarıdır; ileri atılan her adım, sona bir adım daha yaklaşmaktır. Açgözlülük gözlerini kör eder ve ruhlarını sonsuz bir umutsuzluğa sürükler.
gear-armour#0150.flat: Those who believe in chances are the most foolish - every step forward is a step closer to demise. Greed blinds their eyes, as it guides their souls to eternal despair.

gear-armour#0151.src: "Strangest thing, it turns out Creepers are incredibly flammable..." -Garull, Cryptid Researcher
gear-armour#0151.dst: "En tuhafı da şu, meğer Creeper'lar inanılmaz derecede yanıcıymış..." -Garull, Gizemli Yaratık Araştırmacısı
gear-armour#0151.flat: "Strangest thing, it turns out Creepers are incredibly flammable..." -Garull, Cryptid Researcher

gear-armour#0152.src: The gods of air and thunder, frustrated with being physically insubstantial alone, decided to band together to forge the ultimate leggings of defense.
gear-armour#0152.dst: Hava ve yıldırım tanrıları, tek başlarına fiziksel olarak cisimsiz olmaktan bıkınca güçlerini birleştirip savunmanın en üstün tozluğunu dövmeye karar verdiler.
gear-armour#0152.flat: The gods of air and thunder, frustrated with being physically insubstantial alone, decided to band together to forge the ultimate leggings of defense.

gear-armour#0153.src: An eerie glimpse into what once was, shining beautifully in the infinite expanse of the Void. As tragic a tale it is, perhaps it is better left a wisp.
gear-armour#0153.dst: Bir zamanlar var olana ürkütücü bir bakış; Boşluk'un sonsuz enginliğinde güzelce parlıyor. Hikâyesi ne kadar trajik olsa da belki bir pus olarak kalması daha iyidir.
gear-armour#0153.flat: An eerie glimpse into what once was, shining beautifully in the infinite expanse of the Void. As tragic a tale it is, perhaps it is better left a wisp.

gear-armour#0154.src: Found in a mystically-charged Giant ruin, these snug boots recall fond memories, incite calmness, and provide comfort for the wearer.
gear-armour#0154.dst: Mistik enerjiyle yüklü bir Dev harabesinde bulunan bu rahat çizmeler, giyene güzel anılar hatırlatır, sükûnet verir ve huzur sağlar.
gear-armour#0154.flat: Found in a mystically-charged Giant ruin, these snug boots recall fond memories, incite calmness, and provide comfort for the wearer.

gear-armour#0155.src: This ill-fitting, bulky chestplate was never intended to be a chestplate at all. Rather, it is a broken fragment of an arm bracer, from the time of giants.
gear-armour#0155.dst: Bu üstüne oturmayan, hantal göğüslük aslında hiçbir zaman göğüslük olarak tasarlanmadı. Devler çağından kalma bir kol koruyucusunun kırık bir parçasıdır.
gear-armour#0155.flat: This ill-fitting, bulky chestplate was never intended to be a chestplate at all. Rather, it is a broken fragment of an arm bracer, from the time of giants.

gear-armour#0156.src: History measures empires; what are you, if not but a subtle flicker-masked within the brilliance of generations past?
gear-armour#0156.dst: Tarih imparatorlukları ölçer; geçmiş nesillerin parıltısı içinde gizlenmiş belli belirsiz bir kıvılcımdan başka nesin ki?
gear-armour#0156.flat: History measures empires; what are you, if not but a subtle flicker-masked within the brilliance of generations past?

gear-armour#0157.src: "With the corruption seemingly tied to the emeralds dug by the Roots, people thought gold was the next best thing, the idiots." -Gerald, Retired Miner
gear-armour#0157.dst: "Yozlaşma, Roots'un kazdığı zümrütlerle bağlantılı gibi görününce millet en iyi ikinci seçeneğin altın olduğunu sandı, salaklar." -Gerald, Emekli Madenci
gear-armour#0157.flat: "With the corruption seemingly tied to the emeralds dug by the Roots, people thought gold was the next best thing, the idiots." -Gerald, Retired Miner

gear-armour#0158.src: Sometimes it takes a heart of stone to do what must be done.
gear-armour#0158.dst: Bazen yapılması gerekeni yapmak için taştan bir yürek gerekir.
gear-armour#0158.flat: Sometimes it takes a heart of stone to do what must be done.

gear-armour#0159.src: No one knows how this extremely dense chestplate can even logically exist. It is almost paradoxical in nature, and affects its wearers in unfathomable ways.
gear-armour#0159.dst: Bu son derece yoğun göğüslüğün mantıken nasıl var olabildiğini kimse bilmiyor. Doğası neredeyse paradoksaldır ve giyenleri akıl almaz şekillerde etkiler.
gear-armour#0159.flat: No one knows how this extremely dense chestplate can even logically exist. It is almost paradoxical in nature, and affects its wearers in unfathomable ways.

gear-armour#0160.src: Sculpted by searing flames and dazzling light, in the years since the Fracturing the Greatbirds' nest has developed a blinding glow. It has both immense power and volatility, yet seems to hold a hidden strength for one who can tame its spirit.
gear-armour#0160.dst: Kavurucu alevler ve göz kamaştırıcı ışıkla biçimlenen Büyük Kuşların yuvası, Kırılış'tan bu yana kör edici bir parıltı kazandı. Hem muazzam bir güce hem de dengesizliğe sahip, ama ruhunu evcilleştirebilen biri için gizli bir kuvvet barındırıyor gibi.
gear-armour#0160.flat: Sculpted by searing flames and dazzling light, in the years since the Fracturing the Greatbirds' nest has developed a blinding glow. It has both immense power and volatility, yet seems to hold a hidden strength for one who can tame its spirit.

gear-armour#0161.src: Sleek black plates, harder than steel, tougher than granite. Threads of ancient magick weave themselves through the material, granting you all the power of the dark stone.
gear-armour#0161.dst: Çelikten sert, granitten dayanıklı, pürüzsüz siyah plakalar. Kadim büyünün iplikleri malzemenin içinden geçerek sana kara taşın bütün gücünü verir.
gear-armour#0161.flat: Sleek black plates, harder than steel, tougher than granite. Threads of ancient magick weave themselves through the material, granting you all the power of the dark stone.

gear-armour#0162.src: Forged from mystic, previously unknown metals revealed in the deepest dwarven mining site to date, these sleek, glowing greaves are believed to be utterly indestructible.
gear-armour#0162.dst: Bugüne dek kazılmış en derin cüce madeninde ortaya çıkan, daha önce bilinmeyen mistik metallerden dövülen bu zarif, parlayan dizliklerin asla yok edilemeyeceğine inanılır.
gear-armour#0162.flat: Forged from mystic, previously unknown metals revealed in the deepest dwarven mining site to date, these sleek, glowing greaves are believed to be utterly indestructible.

gear-armour#0163.src: The sweater has the quote "I'm feeling PINE, what about you" knitted onto the front.
gear-armour#0163.dst: Kazağın önünde "ÇAM gibiyim, ya sen" yazısı örülü.
gear-armour#0163.flat: The sweater has the quote "I'm feeling PINE, what about you" knitted onto the front.

gear-armour#0164.src: The old facemasks of the Eradian guards were forged from raw magma, and enchanted to remain searingly hot, so as to brand the wearer eternally with the mark of {p}'s elite.
gear-armour#0164.dst: Eradian muhafızlarının eski yüz maskeleri ham magmadan dövülür ve giyeni {p} seçkinlerinin damgasıyla sonsuza dek dağlasın diye kor gibi sıcak kalacak şekilde büyülenirdi.
gear-armour#0164.flat: The old facemasks of the Eradian guards were forged from raw magma, and enchanted to remain searingly hot, so as to brand the wearer eternally with the mark of {p}'s elite.
gear-armour#0164._raw: The old facemasks of the Eradian guards were forged from raw magma, and enchanted to remain searingly hot, so as to brand the wearer eternally with the mark of Rodoroc's elite.

gear-armour#0165.src: The previous owner seems to have met an untimely fate in the undead hordes outside {p}. Stained but salvageable... a little corruption never hurt anybody, yet....It's pulling towards something.
gear-armour#0165.dst: Önceki sahibi, {p} dışındaki ölümsüz sürülerin arasında vakitsiz bir sona ulaşmış gibi görünüyor. Lekeli ama kurtarılabilir... biraz yozlaşmadan kimseye zarar gelmemiştir, şimdilik....Bir şeye doğru çekiyor.
gear-armour#0165.flat: The previous owner seems to have met an untimely fate in the undead hordes outside {p}. Stained but salvageable... a little corruption never hurt anybody, yet....It's pulling towards something.
gear-armour#0165._raw: The previous owner seems to have met an untimely fate in the undead hordes outside Ragni. Stained but salvageable... a little corruption never hurt anybody, yet....It's pulling towards something.

gear-armour#0166.src: A paper cut triggers immediate cauterization. A cracked rib is instantly encased in a cage of white-hot plasma. You did not ask to wake up smoking every morning, but according to diagnostic logs, your survival rate has never been higher.
gear-armour#0166.dst: Bir kâğıt kesiği anında dağlanır. Çatlayan bir kaburga, anında akkor plazmadan bir kafese alınır. Her sabah dumanlar içinde uyanmayı sen istemedin, ama teşhis kayıtlarına göre hayatta kalma oranın hiç bu kadar yüksek olmamıştı.
gear-armour#0166.flat: A paper cut triggers immediate cauterization. A cracked rib is instantly encased in a cage of white-hot plasma. You did not ask to wake up smoking every morning, but according to diagnostic logs, your survival rate has never been higher.

gear-armour#0167.src: An age of formation. To spark the chain reaction of everything, and to predate nothing. To bombard the world with violent impact after violent impact, building a beautiful, delicate foundation from the firestorm of the cosmos. All things must begin.
gear-armour#0167.dst: Bir oluşum çağı. Her şeyin zincirleme tepkimesini başlatmak ve hiçbir şeyden önce gelmemek. Dünyayı şiddetli çarpışmalarla dövmek ve evrenin ateş fırtınasından güzel, narin bir temel inşa etmek. Her şeyin bir başlangıcı olmalı.
gear-armour#0167.flat: An age of formation. To spark the chain reaction of everything, and to predate nothing. To bombard the world with violent impact after violent impact, building a beautiful, delicate foundation from the firestorm of the cosmos. All things must begin.

gear-armour#0168.src: Childhood memories, days of late nights and snow fights and cocoa by the fireside. Loving smiles and friendly faces. The beating heart of the world: home. This is what you fight for, beating back those dark and wicked forces which work to break down all that is loved. There is no sacrifice too great for the hearth.
gear-armour#0168.dst: Çocukluk anıları; gece geç saatler, kartopu savaşları ve şömine başında kakao. Sevgi dolu gülümsemeler ve dost yüzler. Dünyanın atan kalbi: yuva. Uğruna savaştığın şey bu; sevilen her şeyi yıkmaya uğraşan karanlık ve kötü güçleri püskürtüyorsun. Ocak için hiçbir fedakârlık fazla değil.
gear-armour#0168.flat: Childhood memories, days of late nights and snow fights and cocoa by the fireside. Loving smiles and friendly faces. The beating heart of the world: home. This is what you fight for, beating back those dark and wicked forces which work to break down all that is loved. There is no sacrifice too great for the hearth.

gear-armour#0169.src: This peculiar shawl is eternally warm to the touch, and shimmers brilliantly in the sunlight. It is rumored to give amazing health benefits and good fortune to those who wear it.
gear-armour#0169.dst: Bu tuhaf şal dokunulduğunda hep sıcaktır ve güneş ışığında göz alıcı şekilde parıldar. Giyenlere sağlık açısından muazzam faydalar ve iyi talih getirdiği söylenir.
gear-armour#0169.flat: This peculiar shawl is eternally warm to the touch, and shimmers brilliantly in the sunlight. It is rumored to give amazing health benefits and good fortune to those who wear it.

gear-armour#0170.src: Honoring a mythical dwarven smith lost to the legends, these ornately-crafted boots are given only to those who have bested the Mistress of the Hive.
gear-armour#0170.dst: Efsanelerde kaybolmuş mitik bir cüce demirciyi onurlandıran bu süslü işlemeli çizmeler, yalnızca Kovanın Hanımı'nı alt edenlere verilir.
gear-armour#0170.flat: Honoring a mythical dwarven smith lost to the legends, these ornately-crafted boots are given only to those who have bested the Mistress of the Hive.

gear-armour#0171.src: What once crowned the Commander of Aelumia's Gendarmerie, now reduced to a singed fragment of its former self.
gear-armour#0171.dst: Bir zamanlar Aelumia Jandarmasının Komutanına taç olan bu eşya, artık eski halinin kavrulmuş bir parçasından ibaret.
gear-armour#0171.flat: What once crowned the Commander of Aelumia's Gendarmerie, now reduced to a singed fragment of its former self.

gear-armour#0172.src: It bears the visage of a great hero. Thank you for participating in the Festival of the Heroes!
gear-armour#0172.dst: Büyük bir kahramanın çehresini taşıyor. Kahramanlar Festivali'ne katıldığın için teşekkürler!
gear-armour#0172.flat: It bears the visage of a great hero. Thank you for participating in the Festival of the Heroes!

gear-armour#0173.src: The make of this massive cloak is unlike anything seen before among the provinces. Foreign images shift and melt in ethereal projections within the inside.
gear-armour#0173.dst: Bu devasa pelerinin yapımı, eyaletlerde daha önce görülmüş hiçbir şeye benzemiyor. İçinde yabancı görüntüler, ruhani yansımalar halinde kayıp eriyor.
gear-armour#0173.flat: The make of this massive cloak is unlike anything seen before among the provinces. Foreign images shift and melt in ethereal projections within the inside.

gear-armour#0174.src: Many blacksmiths have tried to craft their products in this armor's image, but none so far have been able to capture the brilliance of these Bovemist-blessed greaves.
gear-armour#0174.dst: Pek çok demirci eserlerini bu zırhı örnek alarak yapmaya çalıştı, ama şimdiye dek hiçbiri Bovemist'lerin kutsadığı bu dizliklerin ihtişamını yakalayamadı.
gear-armour#0174.flat: Many blacksmiths have tried to craft their products in this armor's image, but none so far have been able to capture the brilliance of these Bovemist-blessed greaves.

gear-armour#0175.src: Let time slip away. The nature of the mind is to wander, so stare blankly at the sky, let go of your worries, and enjoy a carefree day.
gear-armour#0175.dst: Bırak zaman akıp gitsin. Zihnin doğası gezinmektir; gökyüzüne boş boş bak, dertlerini bırak ve kaygısız bir günün tadını çıkar.
gear-armour#0175.flat: Let time slip away. The nature of the mind is to wander, so stare blankly at the sky, let go of your worries, and enjoy a carefree day.

gear-armour#0176.src: Forgotten long ago, these boots curse the wearer with an endless hunger.
gear-armour#0176.dst: Çoktan unutulmuş bu çizmeler, giyeni bitmek bilmeyen bir açlıkla lanetler.
gear-armour#0176.flat: Forgotten long ago, these boots curse the wearer with an endless hunger.

gear-armour#0177.src: Standing hundreds of metres in the sky, the mist hides the ground far below you. Every step must be taken with caution, or else-
gear-armour#0177.dst: Gökyüzünde yüzlerce metre yüksekte duruyorsun; sis, çok aşağıdaki yeri gizliyor. Her adım dikkatle atılmalı, yoksa-
gear-armour#0177.flat: Standing hundreds of metres in the sky, the mist hides the ground far below you. Every step must be taken with caution, or else-

gear-armour#0178.src: Do you think you can survive with a sky choked by snow and ash? More importantly, do you think anything else can?
gear-armour#0178.dst: Kar ve külle tıkanmış bir gökyüzünün altında hayatta kalabileceğini mi sanıyorsun? Daha önemlisi, başka bir şeyin kalabileceğini mi sanıyorsun?
gear-armour#0178.flat: Do you think you can survive with a sky choked by snow and ash? More importantly, do you think anything else can?

gear-armour#0179.src: Visions unknowable and faces unnamed. A violent cacophony with no end in sight. But beyond that- a clarity. A fleeting moment where the rules speak their names, just on the other side. You need to get closer. You need to be able to see.
gear-armour#0179.dst: Bilinemez görüntüler ve adsız yüzler. Sonu görünmeyen şiddetli bir gürültü cümbüşü. Ama ötesinde- bir berraklık. Kuralların adlarını söylediği kısacık bir an, hemen öbür tarafta. Daha yakına gitmelisin. Görebilmelisin.
gear-armour#0179.flat: Visions unknowable and faces unnamed. A violent cacophony with no end in sight. But beyond that- a clarity. A fleeting moment where the rules speak their names, just on the other side. You need to get closer. You need to be able to see.

gear-armour#0180.src: Only the strongest are able to survive {p}'s unforgivingly harsh conditions. From the frigid temperatures to the vicious wildlife and grotesque corrupteds, life here can feel like challenge after challenge.It's pulling towards something.
gear-armour#0180.dst: {p} bölgesinin acımasızca sert koşullarında yalnızca en güçlüler hayatta kalabilir. Dondurucu soğuktan vahşi hayvanlara ve iğrenç yozlaşmışlara kadar, burada hayat bir sınavdan ötekine geçmek gibi gelebilir.Bir şeye doğru çekiyor.
gear-armour#0180.flat: Only the strongest are able to survive {p}'s unforgivingly harsh conditions. From the frigid temperatures to the vicious wildlife and grotesque corrupteds, life here can feel like challenge after challenge.It's pulling towards something.
gear-armour#0180._raw: Only the strongest are able to survive Nesaak's unforgivingly harsh conditions. From the frigid temperatures to the vicious wildlife and grotesque corrupteds, life here can feel like challenge after challenge.It's pulling towards something.

gear-armour#0181.src: This cheap paper mask drawn in the likeness of Herbert von Legendary as he was having a complete nervous breakdown after having his life threatened by people who would not stop challenging him, is handed over in the ill-conceived hope of easing the murderous tendencies of those who have spent unnecessary amounts of time, broken the mold, gone even further beyond, pushed onward to prove that they will not stop, ultimately garnered an unhealthy obsession, and then came to blows in Doctor Legendary's house demanding further prizes all for the singularly unsettling and quite possibly sociopathic purpose of spending unnecessary amounts of time completing the Legendary Challenge. The inside has the names and addresses of multiple notable psychoanalysts written with a hastily-scrawled note from Doctor Legendary himself begging that you stop completing the Legendary Challenge and go get therapy before you do something to him that would constitute legal action against you.
gear-armour#0181.dst: Hayatını tehdit eden ve ona mücadelektan bir türlü vazgeçmeyen insanlar yüzünden tam bir sinir krizi geçirirken çizilmiş Herbert von Legendary suretindeki bu ucuz kâğıt maske; gereğinden fazla zaman harcamış, kalıpları kırmış, daha da ötesine geçmiş, durmayacaklarını kanıtlamak için ilerlemeyi sürdürmüş, sonunda sağlıksız bir takıntı edinmiş ve ardından yalnızca Legendary Challenge'ı tamamlamak için gereğinden fazla zaman harcamak gibi tekinsiz ve büyük ihtimalle sosyopatça bir amaç uğruna Doktor Legendary'nin evinde daha fazla ödül isteyerek kavgaya tutuşmuş olanların cinayete meyilli eğilimlerini yatıştırma yönündeki akılsızca bir umutla verilir. İçinde birkaç tanınmış psikanalistin adı ve adresi ile Doktor Legendary'nin bizzat aceleyle karaladığı, Legendary Challenge'ı tamamlamayı bırakıp aleyhine yasal işlem başlatılmasını gerektirecek bir şey yapmadan önce terapiye gitmen için yalvardığı bir not var.
ctx: armour/Inconceivably Deranged Paper Mask of Legendary Victory/lore

gear-armour#0182.src: The sweater has the quote "GRAUPELING with a second helping of Craftmas feast" knitted onto the front.
gear-armour#0182.dst: Kazağın önünde "Craftmas ziyafetinden bir tabak daha, DOLU DOLU" yazısı örülü.
gear-armour#0182.flat: The sweater has the quote "GRAUPELING with a second helping of Craftmas feast" knitted onto the front.

gear-armour#0183.src: If the depths of hell allows you this, is staying human an equal trade or a fool's choice?
gear-armour#0183.dst: Cehennemin derinlikleri buna izin veriyorsa, insan kalmak adil bir takas mı, yoksa ahmakça bir seçim mi?
gear-armour#0183.flat: If the depths of hell allows you this, is staying human an equal trade or a fool's choice?

gear-armour#0184.src: There's a note in it. It doesn't seem to be addressed to you... "You're not beyond saving. But you must work to deserve to be saved."
gear-armour#0184.dst: İçinde bir not var. Sana yazılmış gibi görünmüyor... "Kurtarılamayacak durumda değilsin. Ama kurtarılmayı hak etmek için çabalamalısın."
gear-armour#0184.flat: There's a note in it. It doesn't seem to be addressed to you... "You're not beyond saving. But you must work to deserve to be saved."

gear-armour#0185.src: Exploitation is a game as old as time, but rarely one to be played so transparently. When war reaches your doorstep, though, the facade of civility falls-there is no shame in bleeding an enemy dry.
gear-armour#0185.dst: Sömürü, zaman kadar eski bir oyundur, ama nadiren bu kadar açıkça oynanır. Yine de savaş kapına dayandığında medeniyet maskesi düşer; bir düşmanın kanını son damlasına kadar emmekte utanılacak bir şey yoktur.
gear-armour#0185.flat: Exploitation is a game as old as time, but rarely one to be played so transparently. When war reaches your doorstep, though, the facade of civility falls-there is no shame in bleeding an enemy dry.

gear-armour#0186.src: To wear the mark is more than a show of allegiance. It is a willingness to channel the might of the gods at whatever cost, as the fate of the battle is worth more than surviving to see its end.
gear-armour#0186.dst: Bu nişanı taşımak bağlılık göstermekten fazlasıdır. Bedeli ne olursa olsun tanrıların kudretini kanalize etmeye razı olmaktır, çünkü savaşın kaderi sonunu görecek kadar yaşamaktan daha değerlidir.
gear-armour#0186.flat: To wear the mark is more than a show of allegiance. It is a willingness to channel the might of the gods at whatever cost, as the fate of the battle is worth more than surviving to see its end.

gear-armour#0187.src: The last step towards purity. Dissolve and coagulate. Be anew.
gear-armour#0187.dst: Saflığa giden son adım. Çözül ve pıhtılaş. Yeniden doğ.
gear-armour#0187.flat: The last step towards purity. Dissolve and coagulate. Be anew.

gear-armour#0188.src: Death is naught but an inconvenience for the strongest of the corrupted. With time, the weight of destruction will pass, and the fires of War will rise anew from within.It's pulling towards something.
gear-armour#0188.dst: Yozlaşmışların en güçlüleri için ölüm ancak ufak bir aksaklıktır. Zamanla yıkımın ağırlığı geçecek ve Savaş'ın ateşleri içeriden yeniden yükselecek.Bir şeye doğru çekiyor.
gear-armour#0188.flat: Death is naught but an inconvenience for the strongest of the corrupted. With time, the weight of destruction will pass, and the fires of War will rise anew from within.It's pulling towards something.

gear-armour#0189.src: King of the Jungle-it's a title reserved for the apex of the apex, and yet from where you swing across the canopy, this beast of supposed royalty is but another victim of your thievish pursuits.
gear-armour#0189.dst: Ormanın Kralı; bu unvan zirvelerin zirvesine ayrılmıştır, ama ağaçların tepesinde sallanarak geçtiğin yerden bakınca bu sözde asil canavar, hırsızlık maceralarının sıradan bir kurbanından başka bir şey değil.
gear-armour#0189.flat: King of the Jungle-it's a title reserved for the apex of the apex, and yet from where you swing across the canopy, this beast of supposed royalty is but another victim of your thievish pursuits.

gear-armour#0190.src: Brilliantly golden as the crops from the humble farm, its mere presence fills stomachs and brings comfort, but only to those who are modest and generous.
gear-armour#0190.dst: Mütevazı bir çiftliğin ekinleri gibi pırıl pırıl altın rengi olan bu eşyanın yalnızca varlığı bile karınları doyurur ve huzur verir; ama yalnızca alçakgönüllü ve cömert olanlara.
gear-armour#0190.flat: Brilliantly golden as the crops from the humble farm, its mere presence fills stomachs and brings comfort, but only to those who are modest and generous.

gear-armour#0191.src: Used by the Temple of the Legends' strongest guard, the shielded plating is enchanted with a powerful ward to stave off the effects of the corruption.
gear-armour#0191.dst: Temple of the Legends'ın en güçlü muhafızı tarafından kullanılan bu kalkanlı zırh, yozlaşmanın etkilerini uzak tutmak için güçlü bir koruma büyüsüyle büyülenmiştir.
gear-armour#0191.flat: Used by the Temple of the Legends' strongest guard, the shielded plating is enchanted with a powerful ward to stave off the effects of the corruption.

gear-armour#0192.src: The unearthly wood of eyestalk is durable, but with horrific cost. Pieces severed from the trunk continue to collect and cultivate the essence of abandoned eyes, and the unfortunate wearer becomes a catalyst for growth.
gear-armour#0192.dst: Göz sapı ağacının bu dünyaya ait olmayan odunu dayanıklıdır, ama korkunç bir bedeli vardır. Gövdeden koparılan parçalar terk edilmiş gözlerin özünü toplamaya ve yetiştirmeye devam eder; talihsiz giyen de büyümenin katalizörü olur.
gear-armour#0192.flat: The unearthly wood of eyestalk is durable, but with horrific cost. Pieces severed from the trunk continue to collect and cultivate the essence of abandoned eyes, and the unfortunate wearer becomes a catalyst for growth.

gear-armour#0193.src: Masks were carved in his honor, tributes to a chief whose heart of stone was a symbol of boundless, fearless strength. How cruel, then, that when the madness took him, that heart kept its vow to the very end. It warded off death and warded off remorse, leaving behind a monster as cold and unyielding as the cairn in his chest.
gear-armour#0193.dst: Onun onuruna maskeler oyuldu; taştan kalbi sınırsız, korkusuz gücün simgesi olan bir şefe saygı nişaneleri. Ne acımasızdır ki delilik onu ele geçirdiğinde o kalp yeminine sonuna dek sadık kaldı. Ölümü de pişmanlığı da uzak tuttu ve geride, göğsündeki taş yığını kadar soğuk ve katı bir canavar bıraktı.
gear-armour#0193.flat: Masks were carved in his honor, tributes to a chief whose heart of stone was a symbol of boundless, fearless strength. How cruel, then, that when the madness took him, that heart kept its vow to the very end. It warded off death and warded off remorse, leaving behind a monster as cold and unyielding as the cairn in his chest.

gear-armour#0194.dst: "Bacaklara nişan almanın düşmanı etkisiz bırakacağını sanmıştım. Meğer kollarıyla da aynı hızda sürünebiliyorlarmış." -Therck, {p} Askeri, {~}. Tümen
gear-armour#0194.flat: "I thought aiming for the legs would disable the enemy. Turns out they can drag themselves with their arms just as quick." -Therck, {p} Soldier {~}rd Division

gear-armour#0195.flat: Spurred on by a drunken bet, the great {p} smith Kratke improved a pair of leggings from a rival that were once thought to be perfection.

gear-armour#0196.src: You're the only one left. The only light remaining to lift this world out of endless night. Push on; one day, you may make it.
gear-armour#0196.dst: Geriye bir tek sen kaldın. Bu dünyayı sonsuz geceden çıkaracak son ışık. Devam et; bir gün başarabilirsin.
gear-armour#0196.flat: You're the only one left. The only light remaining to lift this world out of endless night. Push on; one day, you may make it.

gear-armour#0197.src: The falling sun shall be your demise.
gear-armour#0197.flat: The falling sun shall be your demise.

gear-armour#0198.src: Due to an unfortunate accident where he choked on a lemon, an unremarkable mercenary became a laughing stock. He later managed to shed the title, as he left no one alive who remembered the name.
gear-armour#0198.dst: Bir limonla boğulduğu talihsiz bir kaza yüzünden sıradan bir paralı asker herkesin alay konusu oldu. Sonradan bu unvandan kurtulmayı başardı, çünkü adını hatırlayan kimseyi sağ bırakmadı.
gear-armour#0198.flat: Due to an unfortunate accident where he choked on a lemon, an unremarkable mercenary became a laughing stock. He later managed to shed the title, as he left no one alive who remembered the name.

gear-armour#0199.src: This thick skinned jacket, imbued with the courage of a thousand lion hearts, will grant the user massive protection from all who target them.
gear-armour#0199.dst: Bin aslan yüreğinin cesaretiyle donatılmış bu kalın deri ceket, kullananı onu hedef alan herkese karşı müthiş bir şekilde korur.
gear-armour#0199.flat: This thick skinned jacket, imbued with the courage of a thousand lion hearts, will grant the user massive protection from all who target them.

gear-armour#0200.src: Break free. Free from the constraints of the flesh, free from the constraints of the mind, free from the constraints of the self.
gear-armour#0200.dst: Kurtul. Etin kısıtlamalarından kurtul, zihnin kısıtlamalarından kurtul, benliğin kısıtlamalarından kurtul.
gear-armour#0200.flat: Break free. Free from the constraints of the flesh, free from the constraints of the mind, free from the constraints of the self.

gear-armour#0201.src: Before the invention of magical weight detectors, there was a giant pair of public scales in {p}. Instead of being thrown away, they were reforged to be a formidable piece of armour.
gear-armour#0201.dst: Büyülü tartı aletleri icat edilmeden önce {p} içinde dev bir halk terazisi vardı. Atılmak yerine yeniden dövülerek zorlu bir zırh parçasına dönüştürüldü.
gear-armour#0201.flat: Before the invention of magical weight detectors, there was a giant pair of public scales in {p}. Instead of being thrown away, they were reforged to be a formidable piece of armour.
gear-armour#0201._raw: Before the invention of magical weight detectors, there was a giant pair of public scales in Cinfras. Instead of being thrown away, they were reforged to be a formidable piece of armour.

gear-armour#0202.src: In the harshest reaches of the mountains, dusk brings a gentle magic to the air, prolonging the faintest vestiges of sundown before night truly falls.
gear-armour#0202.dst: Dağların en sert köşelerinde alacakaranlık havaya yumuşak bir büyü getirir ve gece gerçekten çökmeden önce gün batımının son izlerini uzatır.
gear-armour#0202.flat: In the harshest reaches of the mountains, dusk brings a gentle magic to the air, prolonging the faintest vestiges of sundown before night truly falls.

gear-armour#0203.src: It is cold to the touch until worn. Once donned, it engulfs the wearer in excruciatingly hot flames, but never shall the wearer burn; only their enemies will feel the pain of the fire.
gear-armour#0203.dst: Giyilene dek dokunulduğunda soğuktur. Giyildiğinde, giyeni dayanılmaz sıcaklıkta alevlerle sarar ama giyen asla yanmaz; ateşin acısını yalnızca düşmanları hisseder.
gear-armour#0203.flat: It is cold to the touch until worn. Once donned, it engulfs the wearer in excruciatingly hot flames, but never shall the wearer burn; only their enemies will feel the pain of the fire.

gear-armour#0204.src: The dense, frostbitten trees hide danger at every step, too far to see yet too close to escape.
gear-armour#0204.dst: Sık, ayaz yemiş ağaçlar her adımda tehlike saklar; görülemeyecek kadar uzak, ama kaçılamayacak kadar yakın.
gear-armour#0204.flat: The dense, frostbitten trees hide danger at every step, too far to see yet too close to escape.

gear-armour#0205.src: You'll connive, coerce, lure them in and control it all. Until all cards are set, all pieces in place. Then, when they've all exhausted their usefulness...
gear-armour#0205.dst: Entrika çevirecek, zorlayacak, onları tuzağa çekip her şeyi kontrol edeceksin. Bütün kartlar dağıtılana, bütün taşlar yerine oturana dek. Sonra, hepsinin işi bittiğinde...
gear-armour#0205.flat: You'll connive, coerce, lure them in and control it all. Until all cards are set, all pieces in place. Then, when they've all exhausted their usefulness...

gear-armour#0206.src: "I know the Beast may return one day...but these chains shall bind it for eternity." The inscription glows bright in the darkness.
gear-armour#0206.dst: "Canavar'ın bir gün geri dönebileceğini biliyorum... ama bu zincirler onu sonsuza dek bağlayacak." Yazıt karanlıkta parlıyor.
gear-armour#0206.flat: "I know the Beast may return one day...but these chains shall bind it for eternity." The inscription glows bright in the darkness.

gear-armour#0207.src: Every power has its costs, and every triumph has its toll. Wager everything you treasure-it will all be worth in the end.
gear-armour#0207.dst: Her gücün bir bedeli, her zaferin bir vergisi vardır. Değer verdiğin her şeyi ortaya koy; sonunda hepsine değecek.
gear-armour#0207.flat: Every power has its costs, and every triumph has its toll. Wager everything you treasure-it will all be worth in the end.

gear-armour#0208.src: Not all who roam may find their way home. Others lose themselves in the world... And find a new way forward.
gear-armour#0208.dst: Dolaşan herkes evinin yolunu bulamaz. Kimileri dünyada kendini kaybeder... ve ilerlemek için yeni bir yol bulur.
gear-armour#0208.flat: Not all who roam may find their way home. Others lose themselves in the world... And find a new way forward.

gear-armour#0209.src: The armor worn by the enigmatic Matryoshka Idol. It appears to have a nearly uncountably high number of inlets and sockets set inside.
gear-armour#0209.dst: Gizemli Matryoshka Idol'ün giydiği zırh. İçinde neredeyse sayılamayacak kadar çok oyuk ve yuva var gibi görünüyor.
gear-armour#0209.flat: The armor worn by the enigmatic Matryoshka Idol. It appears to have a nearly uncountably high number of inlets and sockets set inside.

gear-armour#0210.src: The strong can hammer foe and nature alike into submission, waging war with indiscriminate force. The truly powerful pit them against each other on a whim, weaving stone and verdure into an elaborate web of attrition that beats with the heart of an entire world. What is an enemy compared to all the might of the Earth?
gear-armour#0210.dst: Güçlüler düşmanı da doğayı da döve döve boyun eğdirir, ayrım gözetmeyen bir kuvvetle savaşır. Gerçekten kudretli olanlarsa onları canları istediğinde birbirine düşürür; taşı ve yeşilliği, bütün bir dünyanın kalbiyle atan, karmaşık bir yıpratma ağına dokur. Toprağın bütün kudreti karşısında bir düşman ne ki?
gear-armour#0210.flat: The strong can hammer foe and nature alike into submission, waging war with indiscriminate force. The truly powerful pit them against each other on a whim, weaving stone and verdure into an elaborate web of attrition that beats with the heart of an entire world. What is an enemy compared to all the might of the Earth?

gear-armour#0211.src: These boots were retrieved from a frozen man, uncovered on an expedition to {p}. It is believed that the man had been wandering the world before his death.
gear-armour#0211.dst: Bu çizmeler, {p} yolundaki bir keşif gezisinde ortaya çıkarılan donmuş bir adamdan alındı. Adamın ölmeden önce dünyayı dolaştığına inanılıyor.
gear-armour#0211.flat: These boots were retrieved from a frozen man, uncovered on an expedition to {p}. It is believed that the man had been wandering the world before his death.
gear-armour#0211._raw: These boots were retrieved from a frozen man, uncovered on an expedition to Mt. Wynn. It is believed that the man had been wandering the world before his death.

gear-armour#0212.src: Each level deeper into the ocean only harbors stranger and more eerie creatures than before. Though their alien nature is disquieting, it is the way the trend sees no end that worries you the most.
gear-armour#0212.dst: Okyanusun derinliklerine indikçe her seviye öncekinden daha tuhaf ve ürkütücü yaratıklar barındırıyor. Yabancı doğaları tedirgin edici olsa da seni asıl kaygılandıran, bu gidişatın hiç sonunun gelmemesi.
gear-armour#0212.flat: Each level deeper into the ocean only harbors stranger and more eerie creatures than before. Though their alien nature is disquieting, it is the way the trend sees no end that worries you the most.

gear-armour#0213.src: Troubled water shatters the moon into fleeing silver; still water holds it whole. So a clear mind reflects the truth undistorted- and lets the enemy's wrath come like a sword to water.
gear-armour#0213.dst: Çalkantılı su ayı kaçışan gümüş parçalara böler; durgun su ise onu bütün tutar. Berrak bir zihin de gerçeği çarpıtmadan yansıtır ve düşmanın öfkesini suya inen bir kılıç gibi karşılar.
gear-armour#0213.flat: Troubled water shatters the moon into fleeing silver; still water holds it whole. So a clear mind reflects the truth undistorted- and lets the enemy's wrath come like a sword to water.

gear-armour#0214.src: All those who wear these enchanted boots deposit a single fond memory into them. They are forgotten forever, but wearing them recalls every memory within vividly.
gear-armour#0214.dst: Bu büyülü çizmeleri giyen herkes içlerine güzel bir anısını bırakır. O anı sonsuza dek unutulur, ama çizmeleri giymek içlerindeki bütün anıları canlı canlı hatırlatır.
gear-armour#0214.flat: All those who wear these enchanted boots deposit a single fond memory into them. They are forgotten forever, but wearing them recalls every memory within vividly.

gear-armour#0215.src: Sink into infinite synchronous beats with the intricate rhythm of fractals and spirals and patterns, and patterns, and patterns that reach to the pulsating stars and then back to the ground where the people are dancing to songs they don't know under stars that turn ‘round, and around, and around, as the spiral is starting again . . .
gear-armour#0215.dst: Fraktalların, sarmalların ve desenlerin, desenlerin, desenlerin karmaşık ritmiyle sonsuz eş zamanlı vuruşlara dal; titreşen yıldızlara uzanan, sonra da insanların bilmedikleri şarkılarla dans ettiği yere, dönüp duran, dönüp duran, dönüp duran yıldızların altına geri inen desenler, ve sarmal yeniden başlıyor . . .
gear-armour#0215.flat: Sink into infinite synchronous beats with the intricate rhythm of fractals and spirals and patterns, and patterns, and patterns that reach to the pulsating stars and then back to the ground where the people are dancing to songs they don't know under stars that turn ‘round, and around, and around, as the spiral is starting again . . .

gear-armour#0216.src: Ancient bones, fractured by corruption and the elements, have twisted themselves into these leggings. The armor shifts to fit its wearer before turning the bones inwards, inflicting unending agony.It's pulling towards something.
gear-armour#0216.dst: Yozlaşma ve doğa koşullarıyla çatlamış kadim kemikler bükülüp bu tozluğa dönüşmüş. Zırh, kemikleri içe çevirmeden önce giyenin bedenine göre şekil alır ve bitmek bilmeyen bir ızdırap verir.Bir şeye doğru çekiyor.
gear-armour#0216.flat: Ancient bones, fractured by corruption and the elements, have twisted themselves into these leggings. The armor shifts to fit its wearer before turning the bones inwards, inflicting unending agony.It's pulling towards something.

gear-armour#0217.src: Cosmic energy permeates this deceptively dull-looking chestplate, having been crafted with stardust from a comet that only passes over Wynn every {~} years.
gear-armour#0217.dst: Wynn üzerinden yalnızca {~} yılda bir geçen bir kuyrukluyıldızın yıldız tozuyla yapılan bu aldatıcı derecede sıkıcı görünen göğüslüğe kozmik enerji sinmiştir.
gear-armour#0217.flat: Cosmic energy permeates this deceptively dull-looking chestplate, having been crafted with stardust from a comet that only passes over Wynn every {~} years.
gear-armour#0217._raw: Cosmic energy permeates this deceptively dull-looking chestplate, having been crafted with stardust from a comet that only passes over Wynn every 1000 years.

gear-armour#0218.src: The scorching heat, the shifting bodies, the screeching cries of anguish... they're all the least of your problems now.It's pulling towards something.
gear-armour#0218.dst: Kavurucu sıcak, kıpırdayan bedenler, ızdırap dolu çığlıklar... artık bunlar dertlerinin en küçüğü.Bir şeye doğru çekiyor.
gear-armour#0218.flat: The scorching heat, the shifting bodies, the screeching cries of anguish... they're all the least of your problems now.It's pulling towards something.

gear-armour#0219.src: For the belief of the cosmos' defilement, the moon was noted to remain unchanged. Those with this belief live only for the light of the moon, desperately seeking to maintain it through means that would only darken the soul of the most devout. Such from them comes the word lunacy.
gear-armour#0219.dst: Evrenin kirlendiğine dair inanca göre ay değişmeden kalmıştı. Bu inancı taşıyanlar yalnızca ayın ışığı için yaşar ve onu korumak için en dindarın bile ruhunu karartacak yollara çaresizce başvurur. Delilik anlamındaki 'lunacy' sözcüğü de onlardan gelir.
gear-armour#0219.flat: For the belief of the cosmos' defilement, the moon was noted to remain unchanged. Those with this belief live only for the light of the moon, desperately seeking to maintain it through means that would only darken the soul of the most devout. Such from them comes the word lunacy.

gear-armour#0220.src: Threaded with strands of silk from a giant moth, it allows the wearer to dash through the air.
gear-armour#0220.dst: Dev bir güvenin ipek telleriyle dokunmuş bu pelerin, giyenin havada atılmasını sağlar.
gear-armour#0220.flat: Threaded with strands of silk from a giant moth, it allows the wearer to dash through the air.

gear-armour#0221.src: "Some pigmen snuffle through dirt for things to eat. We dig up that soil to plant our crops in; it's always full of life." -Thomas, Ravine Village Resident
gear-armour#0221.dst: "Bazı domuz adamlar yiyecek bir şeyler bulmak için toprağı burnuyla eşeler. Biz o toprağı ekinlerimizi ekmek için kazıyoruz; her zaman hayat doludur." -Thomas, Ravine Köyü Sakini
gear-armour#0221.flat: "Some pigmen snuffle through dirt for things to eat. We dig up that soil to plant our crops in; it's always full of life." -Thomas, Ravine Village Resident

gear-armour#0222.src: The accursed mummy once wore this robe as a great pharaoh of the desert. It has long since rotted, leaving only a cursed shell of its former greatness.
gear-armour#0222.dst: Lanetli mumya bir zamanlar çölün büyük bir firavunuyken bu cüppeyi giyerdi. Çoktan çürümüş, geride eski ihtişamının lanetli bir kabuğundan başka bir şey kalmamış.
gear-armour#0222.flat: The accursed mummy once wore this robe as a great pharaoh of the desert. It has long since rotted, leaving only a cursed shell of its former greatness.

gear-armour#0223.src: Freshly slain foes in well below freezing conditions often provide enough warmth to weather the storm. However, this Corrupted seems to still be alive in some sickening way, draining life force to sustain itself.It's pulling towards something.
gear-armour#0223.dst: Sıfırın çok altındaki koşullarda yeni öldürülmüş düşmanlar çoğu zaman fırtınayı atlatacak kadar sıcaklık sağlar. Ama bu Yozlaşmış, mide bulandırıcı bir şekilde hâlâ hayatta gibi; kendini ayakta tutmak için yaşam gücü emiyor.Bir şeye doğru çekiyor.
gear-armour#0223.flat: Freshly slain foes in well below freezing conditions often provide enough warmth to weather the storm. However, this Corrupted seems to still be alive in some sickening way, draining life force to sustain itself.It's pulling towards something.

gear-armour#0224.src: In such a sinister and wicked expanse, one wonders if the best solution is to give up your eyes and replace them with a pair that does not indulge in such evils, cleansing them from your idyllic field of view while the wider world around you withers away.
gear-armour#0224.dst: Böylesine uğursuz ve kötücül bir diyarda insan, belki de en iyisinin gözlerinden vazgeçip onları bu kötülüklere bulaşmayan bir çiftle değiştirmek olup olmadığını düşünüyor; etrafındaki geniş dünya solup giderken onları kusursuz görüş alanından silmek.
gear-armour#0224.flat: In such a sinister and wicked expanse, one wonders if the best solution is to give up your eyes and replace them with a pair that does not indulge in such evils, cleansing them from your idyllic field of view while the wider world around you withers away.

gear-armour#0225.src: {~} years ago a demonic plague like no other spread through Gavel, killing thousands. That is, until a priest encased the disease inside a helmet and warned everyone never to wear it.
gear-armour#0225.dst: {~} yıl önce Gavel'da eşi benzeri görülmemiş şeytani bir veba yayıldı ve binlerce kişiyi öldürdü. Ta ki bir rahip hastalığı bir miğferin içine hapsedip herkesi onu asla giymemeleri konusunda uyarana dek.
gear-armour#0225.flat: {~} years ago a demonic plague like no other spread through Gavel, killing thousands. That is, until a priest encased the disease inside a helmet and warned everyone never to wear it.
gear-armour#0225._raw: 450 years ago a demonic plague like no other spread through Gavel, killing thousands. That is, until a priest encased the disease inside a helmet and warned everyone never to wear it.

gear-armour#0226.src: This chestplate was originally created as a memorial ornament to the lost lives of {p} before being reforged into a powerful piece of armor for {p}'s guard.
gear-armour#0226.dst: Bu göğüslük aslında {p} şehrinde yitirilen canların anısına bir süs olarak yapılmış, sonra {p} muhafızları için güçlü bir zırha dönüştürülmek üzere yeniden dövülmüştü.
gear-armour#0226.flat: This chestplate was originally created as a memorial ornament to the lost lives of {p} before being reforged into a powerful piece of armor for {p}'s guard.
gear-armour#0226._raw: This chestplate was originally created as a memorial ornament to the lost lives of Ancient Nemract before being reforged into a powerful piece of armor for Nemract's guard.

gear-armour#0227.src: This ancient stone-hewn helmet is blended with the bones of an extinct animal of some kind. It is harder than dragon's hide.
gear-armour#0227.dst: Taştan yontulmuş bu kadim miğfere, soyu tükenmiş bir hayvanın kemikleri karıştırılmış. Ejderha derisinden bile serttir.
gear-armour#0227.flat: This ancient stone-hewn helmet is blended with the bones of an extinct animal of some kind. It is harder than dragon's hide.

gear-armour#0228.src: Forged directly from the bloody red stone mined from the Nether, they were locked away for fear of inciting insanity in those who wore them.
gear-armour#0228.dst: Doğrudan Nether'dan çıkarılan kan kırmızısı taştan dövülen bu eşyalar, giyenleri deliliğe sürükler korkusuyla kilit altına alındı.
gear-armour#0228.flat: Forged directly from the bloody red stone mined from the Nether, they were locked away for fear of inciting insanity in those who wore them.

gear-armour#0229.src: Where thought converges, the veil thins.
gear-armour#0229.flat: Where thought converges, the veil thins.

gear-armour#0230.src: What lies beneath the brim of all that never was, that overflowing vastness which cannot spill?
gear-armour#0230.dst: Hiç var olmamış her şeyin kıyısının altında ne yatar; taşan ama dökülemeyen o enginlikte?
gear-armour#0230.flat: What lies beneath the brim of all that never was, that overflowing vastness which cannot spill?

gear-armour#0231.src: It once held little meaning, another lilac left unnoticed in the quotidian meadows of yesteryear. Yet just its scent brings forth a deluge of memory, crashing down with the force of a time long past.
gear-armour#0231.dst: Bir zamanlar pek bir anlamı yoktu; geçmiş yılların sıradan çayırlarında fark edilmeden kalmış bir leylak daha. Ama yalnızca kokusu bile bir anı selini getiriyor; çok eskilerde kalmış bir zamanın gücüyle üzerine çöküyor.
gear-armour#0231.flat: It once held little meaning, another lilac left unnoticed in the quotidian meadows of yesteryear. Yet just its scent brings forth a deluge of memory, crashing down with the force of a time long past.

gear-armour#0232.src: There is a certain fascination to what lies beyond our grasp, to the spaces we cannot quite see. Harness that pull, draw in your foe, bend it to your will. What could go wrong?
gear-armour#0232.dst: Ulaşamadığımız şeylerde, tam göremediğimiz boşluklarda tuhaf bir büyü vardır. O çekimi dizginle, düşmanını içine çek, iradene boyun eğdir. Ne ters gidebilir ki?
gear-armour#0232.flat: There is a certain fascination to what lies beyond our grasp, to the spaces we cannot quite see. Harness that pull, draw in your foe, bend it to your will. What could go wrong?

gear-armour#0233.src: What's the point of your journey if it all just leads to nothing?
gear-armour#0233.dst: Her şey hiçliğe çıkıyorsa yolculuğunun ne anlamı var?
gear-armour#0233.flat: What's the point of your journey if it all just leads to nothing?

gear-armour#0234.src: Made of dark minerals and adorned with pure obsidian, this ornately-crafted helmet is given only to those who have bested the Mistress of the Hive.
gear-armour#0234.dst: Karanlık minerallerden yapılmış ve saf obsidyenle süslenmiş bu süslü işlemeli miğfer, yalnızca Kovanın Hanımı'nı alt edenlere verilir.
gear-armour#0234.flat: Made of dark minerals and adorned with pure obsidian, this ornately-crafted helmet is given only to those who have bested the Mistress of the Hive.

gear-armour#0235.src: A silhouette of forgotten strength, its essence lingering like a half remembered dream. It no longer boasts the sharpness it once had, yet the stories etched into its very being refuse to fade.
gear-armour#0235.dst: Unutulmuş bir gücün silueti; özü, yarı hatırlanan bir rüya gibi asılı kalıyor. Artık bir zamanki keskinliğine sahip değil, ama varlığına kazınmış hikâyeler solmayı reddediyor.
gear-armour#0235.flat: A silhouette of forgotten strength, its essence lingering like a half remembered dream. It no longer boasts the sharpness it once had, yet the stories etched into its very being refuse to fade.

gear-armour#0236.src: These ancient, spark-coursing greaves are all that remains of the great thunder mage Ohms' favorite golem familiar after a dark force turned it against its masters.
gear-armour#0236.dst: Kıvılcımlar saçan bu kadim dizlikler, büyük yıldırım büyücüsü Ohms'un en sevdiği yardımcı golemden, karanlık bir güç onu efendilerine karşı çevirdikten sonra geriye kalan tek şeydir.
gear-armour#0236.flat: These ancient, spark-coursing greaves are all that remains of the great thunder mage Ohms' favorite golem familiar after a dark force turned it against its masters.

gear-armour#0237.src: Plated with enchanted metals, these magic-warding boots allow faster travel over nearly any solid surface.
gear-armour#0237.dst: Büyülü metallerle kaplanmış, büyüye karşı koruyan bu çizmeler neredeyse her sağlam yüzeyde daha hızlı yol almanı sağlar.
gear-armour#0237.flat: Plated with enchanted metals, these magic-warding boots allow faster travel over nearly any solid surface.

gear-armour#0238.src: Made of an uncommonly used fabric called denim, these fashionable leggings exude style and elegance. Surely wearing them would bring you luck?
gear-armour#0238.dst: Kot denen, pek kullanılmayan bir kumaştan yapılmış bu şık pantolon, tarz ve zarafet saçıyor. Giyersen kesin şans getirir, değil mi?
gear-armour#0238.flat: Made of an uncommonly used fabric called denim, these fashionable leggings exude style and elegance. Surely wearing them would bring you luck?

gear-armour#0239.src: The sweater has the quote "ORANGE you glad I showed up for Craftmas" knitted onto the front.
gear-armour#0239.dst: Kazağın önünde "Craftmas'a geldim diye PORTAKAL gibi açıldın mı" yazısı örülü.
gear-armour#0239.flat: The sweater has the quote "ORANGE you glad I showed up for Craftmas" knitted onto the front.

gear-armour#0241.src: This battered stone mask is of unknown origin, and has no openings for the eyes whatsoever. Indeed, all that can be seen while wearing it is that which makes you truly angry.
gear-armour#0241.dst: Kökeni bilinmeyen bu hırpalanmış taş maskenin gözler için hiçbir deliği yok. Gerçekten de onu takarken görebildiğin tek şey seni gerçekten öfkelendiren şeyler.
gear-armour#0241.flat: This battered stone mask is of unknown origin, and has no openings for the eyes whatsoever. Indeed, all that can be seen while wearing it is that which makes you truly angry.

gear-armour#0242.src: Every ounce of your suffering must be made worth it. Otherwise, what was the point of it all?
gear-armour#0242.dst: Çektiğin her acı damlası buna değmeli. Yoksa bütün bunların ne anlamı vardı?
gear-armour#0242.flat: Every ounce of your suffering must be made worth it. Otherwise, what was the point of it all?

gear-armour#0243.src: There is nothing in these walls that will remain hidden forever. Nothing unaccounted for by the gleaming light of The Citadel.
gear-armour#0243.dst: Bu duvarların içinde sonsuza dek saklı kalacak hiçbir şey yok. The Citadel'in parıldayan ışığının hesabını tutmadığı hiçbir şey yok.
gear-armour#0243.flat: There is nothing in these walls that will remain hidden forever. Nothing unaccounted for by the gleaming light of The Citadel.

gear-armour#0244.src: A brilliant relic supposedly originating from the Realm of Light, the creators of these strangely shaped boots are completely unknown.
gear-armour#0244.dst: Işık Âlemi'nden geldiği söylenen göz kamaştırıcı bir kalıntı; bu tuhaf biçimli çizmeleri yapanlar tamamen bilinmiyor.
gear-armour#0244.flat: A brilliant relic supposedly originating from the Realm of Light, the creators of these strangely shaped boots are completely unknown.

gear-armour#0245.src: Occasional whisperings can be heard by the wearers of this stone mask, reforged from a phylactery of souls. Although not dangerous, staring into the eyes of the mask can bring fear of one's soul being trapped within.
gear-armour#0245.dst: Bir ruh hapsetme muskasından yeniden dövülen bu taş maskeyi takanlar ara sıra fısıltılar duyabilir. Tehlikeli olmasa da maskenin gözlerine bakmak, insanın ruhunun içine hapsolacağı korkusunu uyandırabilir.
gear-armour#0245.flat: Occasional whisperings can be heard by the wearers of this stone mask, reforged from a phylactery of souls. Although not dangerous, staring into the eyes of the mask can bring fear of one's soul being trapped within.

gear-armour#0246.src: Able to withstand the grasp of claws of pure steel, the perch of the Minokawa thrums with the might of a beast that can devour the sun. Given free reign of the skies, even the brightest of stars are no match.
gear-armour#0246.dst: Saf çelikten pençelerin kavrayışına dayanabilen Minokawa'nın tüneği, güneşi yutabilen bir canavarın kudretiyle titreşir. Göklerde dilediğince hüküm sürdüğünde en parlak yıldızlar bile ona denk olamaz.
gear-armour#0246.flat: Able to withstand the grasp of claws of pure steel, the perch of the Minokawa thrums with the might of a beast that can devour the sun. Given free reign of the skies, even the brightest of stars are no match.

gear-armour#0247.src: Salvaged from the limbs of the Vulcor Adrenophage, they radiate extreme heat,  suffusing the body they attach to with that same heat. It almost feels as though your blood is heating to a frenetic boil.
gear-armour#0247.dst: Vulcor Adrenophage'ın uzuvlarından kurtarılan bu parçalar aşırı sıcaklık yayar ve bağlandıkları bedeni de aynı sıcaklıkla doldurur. Neredeyse kanın çılgınca kaynamaya başlamış gibi hissettiriyor.
gear-armour#0247.flat: Salvaged from the limbs of the Vulcor Adrenophage, they radiate extreme heat,  suffusing the body they attach to with that same heat. It almost feels as though your blood is heating to a frenetic boil.

gear-armour#0248.src: An age of transformation. To shape the evolution of life, as if molding a piece of clay. To gain intelligence, and become the harbingers of creation and destruction. To build control, and become the hand of fate. Here, we begin.
gear-armour#0248.dst: Bir dönüşüm çağı. Hayatın evrimini bir parça kili yoğurur gibi şekillendirmek. Zekâ kazanmak ve yaratılışın ve yıkımın habercisi olmak. Hâkimiyet kurmak ve kaderin eli olmak. Burada başlıyoruz.
gear-armour#0248.flat: An age of transformation. To shape the evolution of life, as if molding a piece of clay. To gain intelligence, and become the harbingers of creation and destruction. To build control, and become the hand of fate. Here, we begin.

gear-armour#0249.src: A soul sacrificed willingly, to an eternity in captivity. Imprints and memories; all that remain of a hero of the lands.
gear-armour#0249.dst: Sonsuz bir esarete gönüllü olarak kurban edilmiş bir ruh. İzler ve anılar; diyarların bir kahramanından geriye kalan tek şey.
gear-armour#0249.flat: A soul sacrificed willingly, to an eternity in captivity. Imprints and memories; all that remain of a hero of the lands.

gear-armour#0250.src: Memories take on lives of their own, left long enough.
gear-armour#0250.dst: Yeterince uzun bırakılırsa anılar kendi hayatlarını yaşamaya başlar.
gear-armour#0250.flat: Memories take on lives of their own, left long enough.

gear-armour#0251.src: What better excuse is there to sit in the shade and think about life?
gear-armour#0251.dst: Gölgede oturup hayat üzerine düşünmek için bundan iyi bahane mi olur?
gear-armour#0251.flat: What better excuse is there to sit in the shade and think about life?

gear-armour#0252.src: Rivers will run red in your wake.
gear-armour#0252.flat: Rivers will run red in your wake.

gear-armour#0253.src: The Phoenix Prince is a mythical figure spoken of in Avos legend. His crown cursed him in an endless cycle of death and rebirth.
gear-armour#0253.dst: Phoenix Prince, Avos efsanelerinde anlatılan mitik bir figürdür. Tacı onu sonsuz bir ölüm ve yeniden doğuş döngüsüyle lanetledi.
gear-armour#0253.flat: The Phoenix Prince is a mythical figure spoken of in Avos legend. His crown cursed him in an endless cycle of death and rebirth.

gear-armour#0254.src: The sweater has the quote "Let me NICK a few extra cookies for Craftmas" knitted onto the front.
gear-armour#0254.dst: Kazağın önünde "Craftmas için birkaç kurabiye daha AŞIRAYIM" yazısı örülü.
gear-armour#0254.flat: The sweater has the quote "Let me NICK a few extra cookies for Craftmas" knitted onto the front.

gear-armour#0257.src: The intersection of what can be and what is. The apotheosis of being. Shear away the unclean, the impure, the rotten; leave only the raw, blinding truth of the self.
gear-armour#0257.dst: Olabilecek olanla olanın kesiştiği nokta. Varoluşun doruğu. Kirliyi, katışıklıyı, çürümüşü kes at; geriye yalnızca benliğin çiğ, göz kamaştırıcı gerçeğini bırak.
gear-armour#0257.flat: The intersection of what can be and what is. The apotheosis of being. Shear away the unclean, the impure, the rotten; leave only the raw, blinding truth of the self.

gear-armour#0258.src: These leggings are the last remaining piece of a historical set of armor, created with such power as to be thought impossible long ago.
gear-armour#0258.dst: Bu tozluk, zamanında imkânsız sayılacak kadar güçle yapılmış tarihi bir zırh takımından geriye kalan son parça.
gear-armour#0258.flat: These leggings are the last remaining piece of a historical set of armor, created with such power as to be thought impossible long ago.

gear-armour#0259.src: Smooth yet unassuming, this hollowed piece feels as if it lay untouched for millennia as the chaos that formed eastern Gavel unfolded around it. No blemish nor order, just nature preserved in its most perfect form.
gear-armour#0259.dst: Pürüzsüz ama gösterişsiz bu oyuk parça, doğu Gavel'ı biçimlendiren kaos etrafında yaşanırken binlerce yıl el değmeden kalmış gibi. Ne bir kusur ne bir düzen; yalnızca en kusursuz haliyle korunmuş doğa.
gear-armour#0259.flat: Smooth yet unassuming, this hollowed piece feels as if it lay untouched for millennia as the chaos that formed eastern Gavel unfolded around it. No blemish nor order, just nature preserved in its most perfect form.

gear-armour#0260.src: A tag on the inside of the hat reads: "Do not fly during thunderstorms! The wearer is liable for all injuries sustained while using this product."
gear-armour#0260.dst: Şapkanın içindeki etikette şöyle yazıyor: "Gök gürültülü fırtınalarda uçmayın! Bu ürünü kullanırken oluşan tüm yaralanmalardan kullanıcı sorumludur."
gear-armour#0260.flat: A tag on the inside of the hat reads: "Do not fly during thunderstorms! The wearer is liable for all injuries sustained while using this product."

gear-armour#0261.src: A wolf and a rabbit met in the woods. The rabbit was injured; the wolf spared it. The two grew close. One day, the rabbit fell into a hunter's trap. It was terrified, surrounded by armed men. The wolf burst from the trees, fighting the men back, even as they shot it with their bows, long enough for the rabbit to run away. It never saw the wolf again.
gear-armour#0261.dst: Bir kurt ile bir tavşan ormanda karşılaştı. Tavşan yaralıydı; kurt ona dokunmadı. İkisi yakınlaştı. Bir gün tavşan bir avcı tuzağına düştü. Silahlı adamlarla çevrilmiş, dehşet içindeydi. Kurt ağaçların arasından fırladı ve adamlar onu oklarla vururken bile, tavşan kaçabilene dek onları geri püskürttü. Tavşan kurdu bir daha hiç görmedi.
gear-armour#0261.flat: A wolf and a rabbit met in the woods. The rabbit was injured; the wolf spared it. The two grew close. One day, the rabbit fell into a hunter's trap. It was terrified, surrounded by armed men. The wolf burst from the trees, fighting the men back, even as they shot it with their bows, long enough for the rabbit to run away. It never saw the wolf again.

gear-armour#0262.src: An age of oxidation. To assert that you will remain, and others all across the world will be left behind. To overwhelm everything with toxic air, ensuring that extinctions follow your wake. Some stop breathing, but the gears of time march on.
gear-armour#0262.dst: Bir oksitlenme çağı. Senin kalacağını, dünyanın dört bir yanındaki diğerlerinin ise geride kalacağını ilan etmek. Her şeyi zehirli havayla boğmak ve ardından neslin tükenişlerinin gelmesini sağlamak. Bazıları nefes almayı bırakır, ama zamanın çarkları dönmeye devam eder.
gear-armour#0262.flat: An age of oxidation. To assert that you will remain, and others all across the world will be left behind. To overwhelm everything with toxic air, ensuring that extinctions follow your wake. Some stop breathing, but the gears of time march on.

gear-armour#0263.src: In the shadow of the Sun, a storm of unmistakable hatred follows. One which, however ephemeral, may only yield to the great pyres like these in the minutes it has to spare.
gear-armour#0263.dst: Güneş'in gölgesinde, eşi görülmemiş bir nefret fırtınası onu izler. Ne kadar geçici olursa olsun, kalan dakikalarında ancak bunlar gibi büyük odun yığınlarına boyun eğebilir.
gear-armour#0263.flat: In the shadow of the Sun, a storm of unmistakable hatred follows. One which, however ephemeral, may only yield to the great pyres like these in the minutes it has to spare.

gear-armour#0264.src: The sweater has the quote "ICY you looking at my fancy duds" knitted onto the front.
gear-armour#0264.dst: Kazağın önünde "Şık kıyafetlerime BUZ gibi bakışlar atıyorsun, gördüm" yazısı örülü.
gear-armour#0264.flat: The sweater has the quote "ICY you looking at my fancy duds" knitted onto the front.

gear-armour#0265.src: This patchwork of shells from the Corkian Astrochelys makes for quite the statement sweater; it keeps your neck warm and besides, your foes' fashion fancies feel frivolous, anyway.
gear-armour#0265.dst: Corkus Astrochelys'lerinin kabuklarından yapılmış bu yama işi, tam da dikkat çeken bir kazak oluyor; boynunu sıcak tutar, zaten düşmanlarının dandik defileleri de dert değil.
gear-armour#0265.flat: This patchwork of shells from the Corkian Astrochelys makes for quite the statement sweater; it keeps your neck warm and besides, your foes' fashion fancies feel frivolous, anyway.

gear-armour#0266.src: Radioactive emissions caused by starfall seeps into the mind, the atoms, the Soul. Transfiguring organic matter into something new, something sinister. It's only through sheer force of will that victims of such a thing break free from themselves, and their imperfect vessels... into something beautiful.
gear-armour#0266.dst: Yıldız yağmurunun saçtığı radyoaktif ışınım zihne, atomlara, Ruh'a sızar. Organik maddeyi yeni, uğursuz bir şeye dönüştürür. Böyle bir şeyin kurbanları ancak saf irade gücüyle kendilerinden ve kusurlu bedenlerinden kurtulur... ve güzel bir şeye dönüşür.
gear-armour#0266.flat: Radioactive emissions caused by starfall seeps into the mind, the atoms, the Soul. Transfiguring organic matter into something new, something sinister. It's only through sheer force of will that victims of such a thing break free from themselves, and their imperfect vessels... into something beautiful.

gear-armour#0267.src: One of the few remaining standard issue mails that were used against the first hordes to emerge from the infamous portal over {~} years ago.
gear-armour#0267.dst: {~} yıldan uzun süre önce o kötü şöhretli portaldan çıkan ilk sürülere karşı kullanılan standart zırhlardan elde kalan birkaçından biri.
gear-armour#0267.flat: One of the few remaining standard issue mails that were used against the first hordes to emerge from the infamous portal over {~} years ago.
gear-armour#0267._raw: One of the few remaining standard issue mails that were used against the first hordes to emerge from the infamous portal over 1000 years ago.

gear-armour#0268.src: The harmony of the elements, a world which sings its truth for all who dare listen, words spoken which can be felt but never known. The Sanctuary, in its whole.
gear-armour#0268.dst: Elementlerin uyumu; dinlemeye cesaret eden herkese gerçeğini şarkıyla söyleyen bir dünya, hissedilebilen ama asla bilinemeyen sözler. Sığınak, bütünüyle.
gear-armour#0268.flat: The harmony of the elements, a world which sings its truth for all who dare listen, words spoken which can be felt but never known. The Sanctuary, in its whole.

gear-armour#0270.src: The sweater has the quote "I'll never give you the COLD SHOULDER" knitted onto the front.
gear-armour#0270.dst: Kazağın önünde "Sana asla SOĞUK davranmam" yazısı örülü.
gear-armour#0270.flat: The sweater has the quote "I'll never give you the COLD SHOULDER" knitted onto the front.

gear-armour#0271.src: Ancient and new hearts beat as one.
gear-armour#0271.dst: Kadim ve yeni yürekler tek bir yürek gibi atar.
gear-armour#0271.flat: Ancient and new hearts beat as one.

gear-armour#0272.src: Found on the mangled body of a famous Tromsian general fallen to a corrupted siege some time ago, these boots allow the wearer to remain calm and steadfast in the face of overwhelming odds.It's pulling towards something.
gear-armour#0272.dst: Bir süre önce yozlaşmış bir kuşatmada düşen ünlü bir Troms generalinin parçalanmış cesedinde bulunan bu çizmeler, giyenin ezici bir üstünlük karşısında bile sakin ve kararlı kalmasını sağlar.Bir şeye doğru çekiyor.
gear-armour#0272.flat: Found on the mangled body of a famous Tromsian general fallen to a corrupted siege some time ago, these boots allow the wearer to remain calm and steadfast in the face of overwhelming odds.It's pulling towards something.

gear-armour#0273.src: When the Colossus they called Protector raised its sword, splintering the land like glass, the void opened its jaws to swallow the world. Earthenware dredged from the abyss were reshaped into pieces of armor. They pull at your heels like leaden anchors, and carry the strength of bedrock.
gear-armour#0273.dst: Koruyucu dedikleri Dev kılıcını kaldırıp toprağı cam gibi parçaladığında, boşluk dünyayı yutmak için çenesini açtı. Uçurumdan çıkarılan toprak kaplar yeniden şekillendirilip zırh parçalarına dönüştürüldü. Kurşundan çapalar gibi topuklarını çekiştirir ve ana kayanın gücünü taşırlar.
gear-armour#0273.flat: When the Colossus they called Protector raised its sword, splintering the land like glass, the void opened its jaws to swallow the world. Earthenware dredged from the abyss were reshaped into pieces of armor. They pull at your heels like leaden anchors, and carry the strength of bedrock.

gear-armour#0274.src: In the moments before an all but inescapable death, time slows down, and the pace of battle becomes yours. By mastering the escape, you can face death on command, reaping the benefits at will before the reaper reaches you.
gear-armour#0274.dst: Kaçınılmaz bir ölümden hemen önceki anlarda zaman yavaşlar ve savaşın temposu senin olur. Kaçışta ustalaşarak ölümle dilediğin an yüzleşebilir, Azrail sana ulaşmadan meyvelerini istediğin gibi toplayabilirsin.
gear-armour#0274.flat: In the moments before an all but inescapable death, time slows down, and the pace of battle becomes yours. By mastering the escape, you can face death on command, reaping the benefits at will before the reaper reaches you.

gear-armour#0275.src: An antique passed from the Caritat wreckage into the hands of the outcast elves of {p}. So to honor the memory of the selfless family as inspired their self-imposed exile, their strongest healing spells were imbued into it, and sent to those who needed them most.
gear-armour#0275.dst: Caritat enkazından {p} bölgesinin dışlanmış elflerinin eline geçmiş bir antika. Kendilerine dayattıkları sürgüne ilham veren o özverili ailenin anısını onurlandırmak için en güçlü şifa büyüleri içine işlendi ve en çok ihtiyacı olanlara gönderildi.
gear-armour#0275.flat: An antique passed from the Caritat wreckage into the hands of the outcast elves of {p}. So to honor the memory of the selfless family as inspired their self-imposed exile, their strongest healing spells were imbued into it, and sent to those who needed them most.
gear-armour#0275._raw: An antique passed from the Caritat wreckage into the hands of the outcast elves of Efilim. So to honor the memory of the selfless family as inspired their self-imposed exile, their strongest healing spells were imbued into it, and sent to those who needed them most.

gear-armour#0276.src: Those whose souls are lost to the {p} eternally seek form. They inhabit those who wear these boots, unknowingly dragging the soul of the wearer into their ranks if worn for too long, leaving a wandering husk.
gear-armour#0276.dst: Ruhları {p} içinde kaybolanlar sonsuza dek bir beden arar. Bu çizmeleri giyenlerin içine yerleşir; fazla uzun giyilirse farkında olmadan giyenin ruhunu da saflarına çeker ve geride amaçsızca dolaşan bir kabuk bırakırlar.
gear-armour#0276.flat: Those whose souls are lost to the {p} eternally seek form. They inhabit those who wear these boots, unknowingly dragging the soul of the wearer into their ranks if worn for too long, leaving a wandering husk.
gear-armour#0276._raw: Those whose souls are lost to the Canyon of the Lost eternally seek form. They inhabit those who wear these boots, unknowingly dragging the soul of the wearer into their ranks if worn for too long, leaving a wandering husk.

gear-armour#0277.src: This ornate decorative mask, fashioned from pure silver, is awarded to those who have spent an unnecessary amount of time completing the Legendary Challenge and broken the mold by continuing to spend an unnecessary amount of time completing the Legendary Challenge.
gear-armour#0277.dst: Saf gümüşten yapılmış bu süslü maske, Legendary Challenge'ı tamamlamak için gereğinden fazla zaman harcamış ve Legendary Challenge'ı tamamlamak için gereğinden fazla zaman harcamaya devam ederek kalıpları kırmış olanlara verilir.
