gear-armour#0277.flat: This ornate decorative mask, fashioned from pure silver, is awarded to those who have spent an unnecessary amount of time completing the Legendary Challenge and broken the mold by continuing to spend an unnecessary amount of time completing the Legendary Challenge.

gear-armour#0278.src: Look at the road behind you. The familiar warmth of your journey proves you haven't forgotten your roots, and the familiar faces still standing by your side proves that they are here to stay.
gear-armour#0278.dst: Ardındaki yola bak. Yolculuğunun tanıdık sıcaklığı köklerini unutmadığını, hâlâ yanında duran tanıdık yüzler de kalmaya geldiklerini kanıtlar.
gear-armour#0278.flat: Look at the road behind you. The familiar warmth of your journey proves you haven't forgotten your roots, and the familiar faces still standing by your side proves that they are here to stay.

gear-armour#0279.src: You will do what is right, whether they like it or not.
gear-armour#0279.dst: Doğru olanı yapacaksın, hoşlarına gitse de gitmese de.
gear-armour#0279.flat: You will do what is right, whether they like it or not.

gear-armour#0280.src: A rage has built up in the stones around you. A slow burn, a creeping fury gradually grown throughout the ages. It demands release.
gear-armour#0280.dst: Etrafındaki taşlarda bir öfke birikti. Yavaş yavaş yanan, çağlar boyunca sinsice büyüyen bir hiddet. Dışarı çıkmak istiyor.
gear-armour#0280.flat: A rage has built up in the stones around you. A slow burn, a creeping fury gradually grown throughout the ages. It demands release.

gear-armour#0281.src: "...as intimidating as the name sounds, you want your organs to be trapped in this kind of cage." -Excerpt from Human Anatomy For Fools, Cirh Nettan
gear-armour#0281.dst: "...adı ne kadar korkutucu gelse de organlarının tam da bu tür bir kafeste hapsolmasını istersin." -Aptallar İçin İnsan Anatomisi'nden bir alıntı, Cirh Nettan
gear-armour#0281.flat: "...as intimidating as the name sounds, you want your organs to be trapped in this kind of cage." -Excerpt from Human Anatomy For Fools, Cirh Nettan

gear-armour#0282.src: To fight for a cause so overwhelmingly greater than themselves, under that lofty, unreachable banner. What will they do if it all comes crumbling down; when beliefs and ideals rot away, reduced to naught but ash?
gear-armour#0282.dst: Kendilerinden kat kat büyük bir dava uğruna, o yüce, ulaşılmaz sancağın altında savaşmak. Her şey yıkılırsa ne yapacaklar; inançlar ve idealler çürüyüp külden ibaret kaldığında?
gear-armour#0282.flat: To fight for a cause so overwhelmingly greater than themselves, under that lofty, unreachable banner. What will they do if it all comes crumbling down; when beliefs and ideals rot away, reduced to naught but ash?

gear-armour#0283.src: You know better than anyone else that there's always a sliver of truth behind the tallest of tales.
gear-armour#0283.dst: En abartılı hikâyelerin ardında bile her zaman bir parça gerçek olduğunu herkesten iyi bilirsin.
gear-armour#0283.flat: You know better than anyone else that there's always a sliver of truth behind the tallest of tales.

gear-armour#0284.src: The hide of the centaur is extraordinarily magical in the right hands. It is told to allow the user to gain the swiftness of the horse, but also leaves them vulnerable to hard hitting attacks.
gear-armour#0284.dst: Sentor derisi doğru ellerde olağanüstü büyülüdür. Kullananına atın çevikliğini kazandırdığı, ama onu sert darbelere karşı savunmasız bıraktığı söylenir.
gear-armour#0284.flat: The hide of the centaur is extraordinarily magical in the right hands. It is told to allow the user to gain the swiftness of the horse, but also leaves them vulnerable to hard hitting attacks.

gear-armour#0285.src: Countless lifetimes flash by in an instant. Will you break the cycle, or be consumed by the tides of eternity?
gear-armour#0285.dst: Sayısız ömür bir anda gözlerinin önünden geçiyor. Döngüyü kıracak mısın, yoksa sonsuzluğun dalgalarına mı kapılacaksın?
gear-armour#0285.flat: Countless lifetimes flash by in an instant. Will you break the cycle, or be consumed by the tides of eternity?

gear-armour#0286.src: Blood, gore, and bone fragments have congealed to your shoulder with the power of sheer corruption. The longer the mass is attached to you, the more of you it takes when you try to remove it.It's pulling towards something.
gear-armour#0286.dst: Kan, deşilmiş et ve kemik parçaları saf yozlaşmanın gücüyle omzuna pıhtılaşıp yapışmış. Kütle sana ne kadar uzun yapışık kalırsa, çıkarmaya çalıştığında senden o kadar çok şey koparıyor.Bir şeye doğru çekiyor.
gear-armour#0286.flat: Blood, gore, and bone fragments have congealed to your shoulder with the power of sheer corruption. The longer the mass is attached to you, the more of you it takes when you try to remove it.It's pulling towards something.

gear-armour#0287.src: Once cursed by a druid who had his grove chopped away by a greedy Villager, it was then purified and mass-produced for sale as armor, to the druid's utter disappointment.
gear-armour#0287.dst: Bir zamanlar korusu açgözlü bir Köylü tarafından kesilen bir druid tarafından lanetlenmişti; sonra arındırılıp zırh olarak satılmak üzere seri üretime geçildi, druidin büyük hayal kırıklığına rağmen.
gear-armour#0287.flat: Once cursed by a druid who had his grove chopped away by a greedy Villager, it was then purified and mass-produced for sale as armor, to the druid's utter disappointment.

gear-armour#0288.src: You're seeing red... Time to see more of it.
gear-armour#0288.dst: Gözlerini kan bürüdü... Biraz daha kan görme vakti.
gear-armour#0288.flat: You're seeing red... Time to see more of it.

gear-armour#0289.src: The sweater has the quote "Why be merry? CLAUS I said so" knitted onto the front.
gear-armour#0289.dst: Kazağın önünde "Neden mi neşeliyim? NOEL BABA öyle dedi de ondan" yazısı örülü.
gear-armour#0289.flat: The sweater has the quote "Why be merry? CLAUS I said so" knitted onto the front.

gear-armour#0290.src: It's a wicked dream come true-their purpose is pain, both others' and their own; their will is naught but your command.
gear-armour#0290.dst: Kötücül bir rüya gerçek oldu; amaçları acı, hem başkalarının hem kendilerinin; iradeleri ise yalnızca senin emrinden ibaret.
gear-armour#0290.flat: It's a wicked dream come true-their purpose is pain, both others' and their own; their will is naught but your command.

gear-armour#0291.src: These hollowed spikes still hold the lingering embers of the event that formed this caldera long ago, lending an almost unnatural glow. It's a comforting warmth, though the force of the eruption remains dormant, primed for the slightest push.
gear-armour#0291.dst: Bu oyuk dikenler, uzun zaman önce bu kalderayı oluşturan olayın hâlâ sönmemiş közlerini taşır ve neredeyse doğaüstü bir parıltı yayar. İç ısıtan bir sıcaklık; ama patlamanın gücü uykuda bekliyor, en ufak bir dürtüye hazır.
gear-armour#0291.flat: These hollowed spikes still hold the lingering embers of the event that formed this caldera long ago, lending an almost unnatural glow. It's a comforting warmth, though the force of the eruption remains dormant, primed for the slightest push.

gear-armour#0292.src: The carapace of the common Maexi pet fire scarabs, while alone, only cause minor burns to the touch. However, when woven together, they produce a variety of cumulative effects.
gear-armour#0292.dst: Maexi'nin yaygın evcil ateş böceklerinin kabukları tek başına dokunana yalnızca hafif yanıklar verir. Ama birbirine örüldüklerinde birikerek çeşitli etkiler yaratırlar.
gear-armour#0292.flat: The carapace of the common Maexi pet fire scarabs, while alone, only cause minor burns to the touch. However, when woven together, they produce a variety of cumulative effects.

gear-armour#0293.src: An oasis of flame, where noone can hurt you. Through abhorrence and loathing, you may create a world where all things burn, and a perfectly beautiful world it will be indeed.
gear-armour#0293.dst: Kimsenin sana zarar veremeyeceği bir alev vahası. Tiksinti ve nefretle her şeyin yandığı bir dünya yaratabilirsin; ve o dünya gerçekten kusursuz güzellikte olacaktır.
gear-armour#0293.flat: An oasis of flame, where noone can hurt you. Through abhorrence and loathing, you may create a world where all things burn, and a perfectly beautiful world it will be indeed.

gear-armour#0294.src: Seek the opportune moment. Every wall has a crack that opens when the pressure shifts. Strike decisively when the light seeps through. The treasure will be yours.
gear-armour#0294.dst: Doğru anı kolla. Her duvarın, basınç değiştiğinde açılan bir çatlağı vardır. Işık sızdığında kararlılıkla vur. Hazine senin olacak.
gear-armour#0294.flat: Seek the opportune moment. Every wall has a crack that opens when the pressure shifts. Strike decisively when the light seeps through. The treasure will be yours.

gear-armour#0295.src: Seize the fleeting moment. Every tick of the clock is priceless, so pack every second with thrill, action, and laughter, and live the day to the fullest.
gear-armour#0295.dst: Kaçan anı yakala. Saatin her tıkırtısı paha biçilemez; her saniyeyi heyecan, aksiyon ve kahkahayla doldur, günü doya doya yaşa.
gear-armour#0295.flat: Seize the fleeting moment. Every tick of the clock is priceless, so pack every second with thrill, action, and laughter, and live the day to the fullest.

gear-armour#0296.src: The grave leaves its mark on any who have been there. Few make it out; fewer still can bring their minds, too, back to life.
gear-armour#0296.dst: Mezar, oraya düşen herkesin üzerinde iz bırakır. Pek azı çıkabilir; zihnini de hayata döndürebilenler daha da azdır.
gear-armour#0296.flat: The grave leaves its mark on any who have been there. Few make it out; fewer still can bring their minds, too, back to life.

gear-armour#0297.src: Barrages of rain and ice can bite and break; symphonies thunder and wind can deafen and crash. The worst storms, though, the kind that leave no survivors; those creep up quietly, steal in through the moonlit fields, and whisk the world away without a trace.
gear-armour#0297.dst: Yağmur ve dolu sağanakları ısırabilir, kırabilir; gök gürültüsü ve rüzgâr senfonileri sağır edebilir, yıkabilir. Ama en kötü fırtınalar, geride kimseyi sağ bırakmayanlar, sessizce yaklaşır; ay ışığındaki tarlalardan sızar ve dünyayı iz bırakmadan alıp götürür.
gear-armour#0297.flat: Barrages of rain and ice can bite and break; symphonies thunder and wind can deafen and crash. The worst storms, though, the kind that leave no survivors; those creep up quietly, steal in through the moonlit fields, and whisk the world away without a trace.

gear-armour#0298.src: Bending the fabric of reality to allow the wearer to take massive strides, these boots are rumored to contain rogue djinni to power them.
gear-armour#0298.dst: Gerçekliğin dokusunu büküp giyenin dev adımlar atmasını sağlayan bu çizmelerin, onlara güç veren asi cinler barındırdığı söylenir.
gear-armour#0298.flat: Bending the fabric of reality to allow the wearer to take massive strides, these boots are rumored to contain rogue djinni to power them.

gear-armour#0299.src: A gentle, warm glow for the weak, and flames of condemnation for the wicked. Such is the doctrine you follow, and thus, the will you shall enact upon this earth.
gear-armour#0299.dst: Zayıflar için yumuşak, sıcak bir ışıltı; kötüler içinse lanetleyici alevler. İzlediğin öğreti budur ve bu toprakta uygulayacağın irade de bu olacaktır.
gear-armour#0299.flat: A gentle, warm glow for the weak, and flames of condemnation for the wicked. Such is the doctrine you follow, and thus, the will you shall enact upon this earth.

gear-armour#0300.src: The shifting mosaic that graces the winter skies has always struck you as a faint trace of some grand precursor, pure and whole. As you look up at what remains, fragmented beyond the horizon, you can't help but wonder what it would take to break it once more.
gear-armour#0300.dst: Kış göklerini süsleyen o değişken mozaik, sana hep saf ve bütün, görkemli bir öncülün silik bir izi gibi gelmiştir. Ufkun ötesinde parçalara ayrılmış kalıntılarına bakarken onu bir kez daha kırmanın neye mal olacağını düşünmeden edemiyorsun.
gear-armour#0300.flat: The shifting mosaic that graces the winter skies has always struck you as a faint trace of some grand precursor, pure and whole. As you look up at what remains, fragmented beyond the horizon, you can't help but wonder what it would take to break it once more.

gear-armour#0301.src: Despite being thin enough to blow away in the wind, this mineral-blended shawl holds the force of a supervolcano within its soft fabric.
gear-armour#0301.dst: Rüzgârda uçup gidecek kadar ince olsa da mineral karışımlı bu şal, yumuşak kumaşının içinde bir süper yanardağın gücünü barındırır.
gear-armour#0301.flat: Despite being thin enough to blow away in the wind, this mineral-blended shawl holds the force of a supervolcano within its soft fabric.

gear-armour#0302.src: There have been many attempts to create a reliable power system in {p}, and this plasma-charged helmet was reforged from a notable prototype.
gear-armour#0302.dst: {p} bölgesinde güvenilir bir enerji sistemi kurmak için pek çok girişimde bulunuldu; plazma yüklü bu miğfer de kayda değer bir prototipten yeniden dövüldü.
gear-armour#0302.flat: There have been many attempts to create a reliable power system in {p}, and this plasma-charged helmet was reforged from a notable prototype.
gear-armour#0302._raw: There have been many attempts to create a reliable power system in Llevigar, and this plasma-charged helmet was reforged from a notable prototype.

gear-armour#0303.src: The law of the ancients was clear on the matter. The law of the jungle was, too. Tradition and nature agree: power can only be held by those with the strength to wield it.
gear-armour#0303.dst: Kadimlerin yasası bu konuda açıktı. Ormanın yasası da öyle. Gelenek ve doğa hemfikir: güç ancak onu kullanacak kuvveti olanların elinde kalabilir.
gear-armour#0303.flat: The law of the ancients was clear on the matter. The law of the jungle was, too. Tradition and nature agree: power can only be held by those with the strength to wield it.

gear-armour#0305.src: Many artifacts are found to incite rage in the wearer, and wizards old and new alike conjecture as to the purpose of them. Very few increase the latent abilities of the wearers to ensure havoc, and none to such a degree as these boots.
gear-armour#0305.dst: Pek çok eserin giyende öfke uyandırdığı bilinir ve eski yeni bütün büyücüler bunların amacı üzerine tahminler yürütür. Kaosu garantilemek için giyenin gizli yeteneklerini artıranlar çok azdır ve hiçbiri bu çizmeler kadar değildir.
gear-armour#0305.flat: Many artifacts are found to incite rage in the wearer, and wizards old and new alike conjecture as to the purpose of them. Very few increase the latent abilities of the wearers to ensure havoc, and none to such a degree as these boots.

gear-armour#0306.src: According to the tag on the heels, these boots leave a trail of snow no matter  where one walks with them.
gear-armour#0306.dst: Topuklarındaki etikete göre bu çizmeler nerede yürürsen yürü arkanda kardan bir iz bırakır.
gear-armour#0306.flat: According to the tag on the heels, these boots leave a trail of snow no matter  where one walks with them.

gear-armour#0307.src: These boots were standard issue to members of the prestigious, and now disbanded, Sodeta Guild, and given as a gift to the owners of Delnar Mansion one day.
gear-armour#0307.dst: Bu çizmeler saygın ve artık dağılmış Sodeta Loncası üyelerine verilen standart teçhizattı; bir gün de Delnar Malikânesi sahiplerine hediye edildi.
gear-armour#0307.flat: These boots were standard issue to members of the prestigious, and now disbanded, Sodeta Guild, and given as a gift to the owners of Delnar Mansion one day.

gear-armour#0308.src: A sweet tune permeates the air. A whistle on the waves; a melody from the depths. It calls forth destruction in seafoam and sand, and those who hear its call do not breathe for long.
gear-armour#0308.dst: Havaya tatlı bir ezgi yayılıyor. Dalgaların üstünde bir ıslık; derinlerden bir melodi. Deniz köpüğünde ve kumda yıkımı çağırır; çağrısını duyanlar uzun süre nefes alamaz.
gear-armour#0308.flat: A sweet tune permeates the air. A whistle on the waves; a melody from the depths. It calls forth destruction in seafoam and sand, and those who hear its call do not breathe for long.

gear-armour#0309.src: Taken from the Archwraith by a pious Shaman, this chestplate was immediately abandoned. Its few users since have turned to an all-consuming desire to seek out and realign the last vestiges of purity remaining in the {p}.
gear-armour#0309.dst: Dindar bir Şaman tarafından Archwraith'ten alınan bu göğüslük hemen terk edildi. O zamandan beri kullanan birkaç kişi, {p} içinde kalan son saflık kırıntılarını bulup yeniden düzenlemeye yönelik her şeyi yutan bir arzuya kapıldı.
gear-armour#0309.flat: Taken from the Archwraith by a pious Shaman, this chestplate was immediately abandoned. Its few users since have turned to an all-consuming desire to seek out and realign the last vestiges of purity remaining in the {p}.
gear-armour#0309._raw: Taken from the Archwraith by a pious Shaman, this chestplate was immediately abandoned. Its few users since have turned to an all-consuming desire to seek out and realign the last vestiges of purity remaining in the Kander Forest.

gear-armour#0310.src: Your mind is ripped away from reality, puppeting the ghost of a vessel that once held your brilliant spirit. But here, now, you can do things you never before thought possible. They cannot touch you here, here in the realm where the shadows live.
gear-armour#0310.dst: Zihnin gerçeklikten kopartılıyor; bir zamanlar parlak ruhunu taşıyan bir bedenin hayaletini kukla gibi oynatıyorsun. Ama burada, şimdi, daha önce imkânsız sandığın şeyleri yapabilirsin. Sana burada dokunamazlar; gölgelerin yaşadığı bu diyarda.
gear-armour#0310.flat: Your mind is ripped away from reality, puppeting the ghost of a vessel that once held your brilliant spirit. But here, now, you can do things you never before thought possible. They cannot touch you here, here in the realm where the shadows live.

gear-armour#0311.src: The dark spectres of the decayed forests have created an insidious helmet to drain the spirit of those who wear it, and become servants to their dark whims. Many have fallen to its allure.
gear-armour#0311.dst: Çürümüş ormanların karanlık hayaletleri, giyenlerin ruhunu emip onları karanlık heveslerinin hizmetkârı yapan sinsi bir miğfer yarattı. Pek çoğu onun cazibesine kapıldı.
gear-armour#0311.flat: The dark spectres of the decayed forests have created an insidious helmet to drain the spirit of those who wear it, and become servants to their dark whims. Many have fallen to its allure.

gear-armour#0312.src: "...Spiders have a weak point in the cephalothorax, essentially the neck. A small target, but it isn't as tough to chop through as the rest of them. ..." -Admiral Aegis' Guide To Nivla Threats, Chapter {~}
gear-armour#0312.dst: "...Örümceklerin baş-göğüs kısmında, yani aslında boyunlarında zayıf bir nokta vardır. Küçük bir hedef, ama vücudun geri kalanı kadar zor kesilmez. ..." -Amiral Aegis'in Nivla Tehditleri Rehberi, Bölüm {~}
gear-armour#0312.flat: "...Spiders have a weak point in the cephalothorax, essentially the neck. A small target, but it isn't as tough to chop through as the rest of them. ..." -Admiral Aegis' Guide To Nivla Threats, Chapter {~}
gear-armour#0312._raw: "...Spiders have a weak point in the cephalothorax, essentially the neck. A small target, but it isn't as tough to chop through as the rest of them. ..." -Admiral Aegis' Guide To Nivla Threats, Chapter 3

gear-armour#0313.src: "After nearly getting trapped in an iron maiden, I figure I can study  those mummies just as well from home." -Achper, {p} Archaeologist
gear-armour#0313.dst: "Az kalsın bir demir kızın içinde kapana kısılıyordum; o mumyaları evden de pekâlâ inceleyebilirim bence." -Achper, {p} Arkeoloğu
gear-armour#0313.flat: "After nearly getting trapped in an iron maiden, I figure I can study  those mummies just as well from home." -Achper, {p} Archaeologist
gear-armour#0313._raw: "After nearly getting trapped in an iron maiden, I figure I can study  those mummies just as well from home." -Achper, Almuj Archaeologist

gear-armour#0314.src: Although these boots are crafted from corrupted stone, they do not exhibit any corruptive effects on their wearers. Speculation abounds as to the reason.
gear-armour#0314.dst: Bu çizmeler yozlaşmış taştan yapılmış olsa da giyenlerde hiçbir yozlaştırıcı etki göstermiyor. Nedenine dair türlü türlü tahmin yürütülüyor.
gear-armour#0314.flat: Although these boots are crafted from corrupted stone, they do not exhibit any corruptive effects on their wearers. Speculation abounds as to the reason.

gear-armour#0316.src: Wybels have a strange attraction to cosmic magic, and many an owner will find them staring through the window at night. One, however, claims to have seen her Wybel making something out of white stardust. The abode was robbed shortly after, and the supposed item gone missing without confirmation of its existence.
gear-armour#0316.dst: Wybel'lerin kozmik büyüye karşı tuhaf bir ilgisi vardır; pek çok sahibi onları geceleri pencereden dışarı bakarken bulur. Ama biri, Wybel'inin beyaz yıldız tozundan bir şey yaptığını gördüğünü iddia ediyor. Ev kısa süre sonra soyuldu ve varlığı doğrulanamayan o eşya kayboldu.
gear-armour#0316.flat: Wybels have a strange attraction to cosmic magic, and many an owner will find them staring through the window at night. One, however, claims to have seen her Wybel making something out of white stardust. The abode was robbed shortly after, and the supposed item gone missing without confirmation of its existence.

gear-armour#0317.src: Forged in a hidden workshop, these boots were imbued with earthen quartz and bound lightning. Their wearer crackles with static energy, amplifying every strike. Many have chased this power, only to find themselves uprooted by its shocking embrace.
gear-armour#0317.dst: Gizli bir atölyede dövülen bu çizmelere toprak kuvarsı ve bağlanmış yıldırım işlendi. Giyen statik enerjiyle çatırdar ve her darbesi güçlenir. Pek çoğu bu gücün peşine düştü, ama sonunda onun çarpıcı kucaklamasıyla yerinden söküldü.
gear-armour#0317.flat: Forged in a hidden workshop, these boots were imbued with earthen quartz and bound lightning. Their wearer crackles with static energy, amplifying every strike. Many have chased this power, only to find themselves uprooted by its shocking embrace.

gear-armour#0318.src: Ground yourself. Your heart beats to the rhythm of the earth. With the weight of the world supporting you, nothing can break your stride.
gear-armour#0318.dst: Ayaklarını yere bas. Kalbin toprağın ritmiyle atıyor. Dünyanın ağırlığı arkandayken hiçbir şey adımını bozamaz.
gear-armour#0318.flat: Ground yourself. Your heart beats to the rhythm of the earth. With the weight of the world supporting you, nothing can break your stride.

gear-armour#0319.src: A rogue inventor stole the plans for a steam jet booster from Corkus and reverse engineered them onto a set of boots. While effective, they are dangerous, prone to catastrophic failure.
gear-armour#0319.dst: Kanun kaçağı bir mucit, Corkus'tan bir buhar jeti hızlandırıcısının planlarını çaldı ve tersine mühendislikle bir çift çizmeye uyguladı. Etkililer ama tehlikeliler; felaketle sonuçlanan arızalara meyilliler.
gear-armour#0319.flat: A rogue inventor stole the plans for a steam jet booster from Corkus and reverse engineered them onto a set of boots. While effective, they are dangerous, prone to catastrophic failure.

gear-armour#0320.src: The beauty of this peculiar grotto takes your breath away. Unfortunately, its spores do too...
gear-armour#0320.dst: Bu tuhaf mağaranın güzelliği nefesini kesiyor. Ne yazık ki sporları da öyle...
gear-armour#0320.flat: The beauty of this peculiar grotto takes your breath away. Unfortunately, its spores do too...

gear-armour#0321.src: "You should see when the spiders fight over a meal. It looks ridiculous, legs flailing everywhere!" -Captain Enduyn, {p} Legion {~}st Division
gear-armour#0321.dst: "Örümcekler bir yemek için kavga ettiğinde görmen lazım. Saçma görünüyor, bacaklar her yere savruluyor!" -Kaptan Enduyn, {p} Lejyonu, {~}. Tümen
gear-armour#0321.flat: "You should see when the spiders fight over a meal. It looks ridiculous, legs flailing everywhere!" -Captain Enduyn, {p} Legion {~}st Division
gear-armour#0321._raw: "You should see when the spiders fight over a meal. It looks ridiculous, legs flailing everywhere!" -Captain Enduyn, Ragni Legion 1st Division

gear-armour#0322.src: The carving on this archaic piece of armor writes: Ketlednah Icsul
gear-armour#0322.dst: Bu eski zırh parçasının üzerindeki oymada şu yazıyor: Ketlednah Icsul
gear-armour#0322.flat: The carving on this archaic piece of armor writes: Ketlednah Icsul

gear-armour#0323.src: Forged from the storm-touched ether, this chest piece calls its wearer to rise above the sky. With every step, the pull of the earth weakens. Jump, and for a moment, you are weightless-caught between the clouds and the stars. Leap, and the heavens may answer.
gear-armour#0323.dst: Fırtınanın dokunduğu esirden dövülen bu göğüslük, giyenini göğün üstüne yükselmeye çağırır. Her adımda toprağın çekimi zayıflar. Zıpla, bir anlığına ağırlıksız kalırsın; bulutlarla yıldızlar arasında asılı. Sıçra, belki gökler cevap verir.
gear-armour#0323.flat: Forged from the storm-touched ether, this chest piece calls its wearer to rise above the sky. With every step, the pull of the earth weakens. Jump, and for a moment, you are weightless-caught between the clouds and the stars. Leap, and the heavens may answer.

gear-armour#0324.src: The cost of survival is immense, with morale running thin and supply lines choked, feeding the strength of an army condensed to a single point, of a people desperate not to give an inch.
gear-armour#0324.dst: Hayatta kalmanın bedeli muazzamdır; moral tükenirken ve ikmal hatları tıkanmışken tek bir noktaya sıkışmış bir ordunun, bir karış bile toprak vermemeye çabalayan bir halkın gücünü besler.
gear-armour#0324.flat: The cost of survival is immense, with morale running thin and supply lines choked, feeding the strength of an army condensed to a single point, of a people desperate not to give an inch.

gear-armour#0325.src: Echoes of the Fracturing persist in the Sky at scales unimaginable, implying a power so all-encompassing it leaves you in awe.
gear-armour#0325.dst: Kırılış'ın yankıları Gökyüzü'nde hayal bile edilemeyecek ölçeklerde sürüyor; seni hayranlıkla bırakacak kadar her şeyi kuşatan bir güce işaret ediyor.
gear-armour#0325.flat: Echoes of the Fracturing persist in the Sky at scales unimaginable, implying a power so all-encompassing it leaves you in awe.

gear-armour#0326.src: The most poignant anthems are the toils of a tortured soul, a haunting, heart-wrenching melody from which one can never turn away.
gear-armour#0326.dst: En dokunaklı marşlar işkence görmüş bir ruhun çileleridir; insanın asla arkasını dönemeyeceği, akıldan çıkmayan, yürek burkan bir melodi.
gear-armour#0326.flat: The most poignant anthems are the toils of a tortured soul, a haunting, heart-wrenching melody from which one can never turn away.

gear-armour#0327.src: The Expanse holds an exigent paranoia, a hamartia for even the most renowned heroes. Only a survivor knows to hoard intelligence, showing their hand only when none will be left to recount it.
gear-armour#0327.dst: Expanse, en ünlü kahramanlar için bile ölümcül bir kusur olan ısrarlı bir paranoya barındırır. İstihbaratı biriktirmeyi ve elini ancak bunu anlatacak kimse kalmayacakken açmayı yalnızca hayatta kalan bilir.
gear-armour#0327.flat: The Expanse holds an exigent paranoia, a hamartia for even the most renowned heroes. Only a survivor knows to hoard intelligence, showing their hand only when none will be left to recount it.

gear-armour#0328.src: The hide of the Touroto, an almost invincible Bull-like creature, is said to be pierced only by the horn of the Touroto itself, making it extremely valuable.
gear-armour#0328.dst: Neredeyse yenilmez, Boğa'ya benzer bir yaratık olan Touroto'nun derisini yalnızca Touroto'nun kendi boynuzunun delebildiği söylenir; bu yüzden son derece değerlidir.
gear-armour#0328.flat: The hide of the Touroto, an almost invincible Bull-like creature, is said to be pierced only by the horn of the Touroto itself, making it extremely valuable.

gear-armour#0330.src: Worn by a terrible berserker during his fanatical rampage through the land, his rage permeates this horned blackiron helmet.
gear-armour#0330.dst: Korkunç bir çılgın savaşçının topraklarda fanatik bir yıkıma giriştiği sırada giydiği bu boynuzlu kara demir miğfere onun öfkesi sinmiştir.
gear-armour#0330.flat: Worn by a terrible berserker during his fanatical rampage through the land, his rage permeates this horned blackiron helmet.

gear-armour#0331.src: While only a mockery of the original product, this line of helmets became wildly popular before legal disputes and safety concerns halted production.
gear-armour#0331.dst: Orijinal ürünün kötü bir taklidinden ibaret olsa da bu miğfer serisi, hukuki anlaşmazlıklar ve güvenlik kaygıları üretimi durdurana dek inanılmaz popüler oldu.
gear-armour#0331.flat: While only a mockery of the original product, this line of helmets became wildly popular before legal disputes and safety concerns halted production.

gear-armour#0332.src: Jingle jangle, while shaking your bells. Jingle jangle come the pockets of cash... Catch the trickster, send them to hell," their money is gone and off you've dashed!
gear-armour#0332.dst: Şıngır mıngır, çanların sallanır. Şıngır mıngır gelir para dolu ceplerin... Hilebazı yakala, cehenneme yolla," paraları gitti, sen de çoktan tüydün!
gear-armour#0332.flat: Jingle jangle, while shaking your bells. Jingle jangle come the pockets of cash... Catch the trickster, send them to hell," their money is gone and off you've dashed!

gear-armour#0333.src: To the victor go the spoils. To the swift, go the spoils of the victor.
gear-armour#0333.dst: Ganimet galibindir. Galibin ganimeti de hızlı olanındır.
gear-armour#0333.flat: To the victor go the spoils. To the swift, go the spoils of the victor.

gear-armour#0334.src: "I have hope in me the likes of which you could never imagine, and despair the likes of which you shall never fathom. If I cannot satisfy the one, then I will indulge the other."
gear-armour#0334.dst: "İçimde senin asla hayal edemeyeceğin bir umut, asla kavrayamayacağın bir umutsuzluk var. Birini doyuramıyorsam, ötekinin hakkını veririm."
gear-armour#0334.flat: "I have hope in me the likes of which you could never imagine, and despair the likes of which you shall never fathom. If I cannot satisfy the one, then I will indulge the other."

gear-armour#0335.src: The scratching in the walls is the only warning you get.
gear-armour#0335.dst: Duvarların içindeki tırmalama sesi alacağın tek uyarı.
gear-armour#0335.flat: The scratching in the walls is the only warning you get.

gear-armour#0336.src: The Bantisu monks have developed this enigmatic sigil in their years of meditation and study. It blesses the wearer with luck and powerful psionic ability.
gear-armour#0336.dst: Bantisu keşişleri bu gizemli mührü yıllar süren meditasyon ve çalışmalarıyla geliştirdi. Giyeni şansla ve güçlü psiyonik yetenekle kutsar.
gear-armour#0336.flat: The Bantisu monks have developed this enigmatic sigil in their years of meditation and study. It blesses the wearer with luck and powerful psionic ability.

gear-armour#0337.src: The home of the storms, where the cramped clouds crackle and power surges in sharp bolts.
gear-armour#0337.dst: Fırtınaların yuvası; sıkışmış bulutların çatırdadığı, gücün keskin şimşeklerle dalgalandığı yer.
gear-armour#0337.flat: The home of the storms, where the cramped clouds crackle and power surges in sharp bolts.

gear-armour#0338.src: You only have limited time. But what if, you could experience that time again? And again, and again...
gear-armour#0338.dst: Sınırlı bir zamanın var. Peki ya o zamanı yeniden yaşayabilseydin? Ve yeniden, ve yeniden...
gear-armour#0338.flat: You only have limited time. But what if, you could experience that time again? And again, and again...

gear-armour#0339.src: Chronological anomalies sometimes split themselves open, with no rhyme or reason. Catch one at the right time, and you'll find yourself somewhen else.
gear-armour#0339.dst: Zamansal anomaliler bazen hiçbir mantığı olmadan kendiliğinden yarılır. Doğru zamanda birine yakalanırsan kendini başka bir zamanda bulursun.
gear-armour#0339.flat: Chronological anomalies sometimes split themselves open, with no rhyme or reason. Catch one at the right time, and you'll find yourself somewhen else.

gear-armour#0340.src: Tisaun, a warrior tasked to fend off a corrupted siege alone, could find only a thin shirt and rusted spear to use before the attack. He defeated all {~} enemies without taking a scratch, and his bravery infused his gear with that same strength.
gear-armour#0340.dst: Yozlaşmış bir kuşatmayı tek başına püskürtmekle görevlendirilen savaşçı Tisaun, saldırıdan önce yalnızca ince bir gömlek ve paslı bir mızrak bulabildi. {~} düşmanın hepsini tek bir çizik almadan yendi ve cesareti teçhizatına da aynı gücü işledi.
gear-armour#0340.flat: Tisaun, a warrior tasked to fend off a corrupted siege alone, could find only a thin shirt and rusted spear to use before the attack. He defeated all {~} enemies without taking a scratch, and his bravery infused his gear with that same strength.
gear-armour#0340._raw: Tisaun, a warrior tasked to fend off a corrupted siege alone, could find only a thin shirt and rusted spear to use before the attack. He defeated all 1000 enemies without taking a scratch, and his bravery infused his gear with that same strength.

gear-armour#0341.src: Crudely misshapen greaves made from haphazard scrap found about the Starfield. You sense a foreboding notion that donning such a thing would be the end of sensing anything at all.
gear-armour#0341.dst: Starfield çevresinde bulunan gelişigüzel hurdalardan yapılmış, kabaca biçimsiz dizlikler. Böyle bir şeyi giymenin, bir şey hissetmenin sonu olacağına dair kötü bir önsezi duyuyorsun.
gear-armour#0341.flat: Crudely misshapen greaves made from haphazard scrap found about the Starfield. You sense a foreboding notion that donning such a thing would be the end of sensing anything at all.

gear-armour#0342.src: This is futile, a fight against odds so great you may as well challenge the force of fate itself. Yet there is pride to be found in delaying the inevitable, so stand your ground and fight to the end.
gear-armour#0342.dst: Bu boşuna; öylesine büyük bir olasılığa karşı bir savaş ki kaderin gücüne meydan okusan daha iyi. Yine de kaçınılmaz olanı geciktirmenin bir gururu vardır; yerinde dur ve sonuna dek savaş.
gear-armour#0342.flat: This is futile, a fight against odds so great you may as well challenge the force of fate itself. Yet there is pride to be found in delaying the inevitable, so stand your ground and fight to the end.

gear-armour#0343.src: There's a new voice in your head. An echo, a scratch at the back of your brain, bursting with all the memories of a life you've never led and the desires of a will you do not hold and the fears of a mind that is not yours. Won't you let it out? After all, two hearts beat stronger than one.
gear-armour#0343.dst: Kafanda yeni bir ses var. Bir yankı, beyninin arkasında bir tırmalama; hiç yaşamadığın bir hayatın anılarıyla, sahip olmadığın bir iradenin arzularıyla ve sana ait olmayan bir zihnin korkularıyla dolup taşıyor. Dışarı çıkmasına izin vermez misin? Ne de olsa iki kalp, birinden daha güçlü atar.
gear-armour#0343.flat: There's a new voice in your head. An echo, a scratch at the back of your brain, bursting with all the memories of a life you've never led and the desires of a will you do not hold and the fears of a mind that is not yours. Won't you let it out? After all, two hearts beat stronger than one.

gear-armour#0344.src: In sleep we are unfettered, unhindered by the choices we make. In dream we are unbound, set free to the limits of imagination.
gear-armour#0344.dst: Uykuda özgürüz; seçimlerimiz bize engel olmaz. Düşte zincirsiziz; hayal gücünün sınırlarına dek serbest bırakılırız.
gear-armour#0344.flat: In sleep we are unfettered, unhindered by the choices we make. In dream we are unbound, set free to the limits of imagination.

gear-armour#0345.src: This excessively ornate to-the-point-of-being-wasteful decorative mask, laser-cut from a meter's worth of pure diamond, is given to those who have spent an unnecessary amount of time completing the Legendary Challenge, broken the mold by continuing to spend an unnecessary amount of time completing the Legendary Challenge, gone even further beyond spending unnecessary amounts of time completing the Legendary Challenge, and then pushed onward to prove that they will not stop spending unnecessary amounts of time completing the Legendary Challenge.
gear-armour#0345.dst: Bir metrelik saf elmastan lazerle kesilmiş, israf derecesinde süslü bu dekoratif maske; Legendary Challenge'ı tamamlamaya gereksiz miktarda zaman harcamış, Legendary Challenge'ı tamamlamaya gereksiz miktarda zaman harcamayı sürdürerek kalıpları kırmış, Legendary Challenge'ı tamamlamaya gereksiz miktarda zaman harcamanın da ötesine geçmiş ve ardından Legendary Challenge'ı tamamlamaya gereksiz miktarda zaman harcamaktan vazgeçmeyeceklerini kanıtlamak için yola devam etmiş olanlara verilir.

gear-armour#0345.flat: This excessively ornate to-the-point-of-being-wasteful decorative mask, laser-cut from a meter's worth of pure diamond, is given to those who have spent an unnecessary amount of time completing the Legendary Challenge, broken the mold by continuing to spend an unnecessary amount of time completing the Legendary Challenge, gone even further beyond spending unnecessary amounts of time completing the Legendary Challenge, and then pushed onward to prove that they will not stop spending unnecessary amounts of time completing the Legendary Challenge.

gear-armour#0346.src: Wait it out. Even the darkest storm clouds will eventually run out of rain if you give them enough time. Step back. Breathe. The sky clears on its own once the sun has had its say.
gear-armour#0346.dst: Bekle, geçsin. En kara fırtına bulutlarının bile, yeterince zaman verirsen eninde sonunda yağmuru tükenir. Bir adım geri çekil. Nefes al. Güneş sözünü söyleyince gökyüzü kendiliğinden açılır.
gear-armour#0346.flat: Wait it out. Even the darkest storm clouds will eventually run out of rain if you give them enough time. Step back. Breathe. The sky clears on its own once the sun has had its say.

gear-armour#0347.src: An ephemeral moment in time captured by sheer force of magic, this ornately-crafted cloak is given only to those who have bested the Mistress of the Hive.
gear-armour#0347.dst: Saf büyü gücüyle yakalanmış, geçici bir zaman anı. Bu özenle işlenmiş pelerin yalnızca Kovanın Hanımı'nı alt edenlere verilir.
gear-armour#0347.flat: An ephemeral moment in time captured by sheer force of magic, this ornately-crafted cloak is given only to those who have bested the Mistress of the Hive.

gear-armour#0349.src: The Wanderer; the Betrayer; the Lunatic.
gear-armour#0349.flat: The Wanderer; the Betrayer; the Lunatic.

gear-armour#0350.src: A once-great hero left behind these sturdy, reliable greaves, trusting those after her to be able to use their power to protect others, should they don them. Her courage fuels their wearers.
gear-armour#0350.dst: Bir zamanlar büyük olan bir kahraman, bu sağlam ve güvenilir dizlikleri ardında bıraktı; onları giyenlerin güçlerini başkalarını korumak için kullanacağına güveniyordu. Onun cesareti, giyenlere güç verir.
gear-armour#0350.flat: A once-great hero left behind these sturdy, reliable greaves, trusting those after her to be able to use their power to protect others, should they don them. Her courage fuels their wearers.

gear-armour#0352.src: This ancient Elven sacrificial mask contains only a sliver of its previous magic, yet the blessing of the Elven god Entia still greatly empowers those who don it.
gear-armour#0352.dst: Bu kadim Elf kurban maskesinde eski büyüsünden yalnızca bir kırıntı kalmıştır, yine de Elf tanrısı Entia'nın kutsaması onu takanları hâlâ büyük ölçüde güçlendirir.
gear-armour#0352.flat: This ancient Elven sacrificial mask contains only a sliver of its previous magic, yet the blessing of the Elven god Entia still greatly empowers those who don it.

gear-armour#0353.src: Fashioned from the cut tails of the now extinct Venti, these nearly immaterial boots are light as air and crackle with lightning.
gear-armour#0353.dst: Artık soyu tükenmiş Venti'lerin kesilmiş kuyruklarından yapılan bu neredeyse maddesiz çizmeler, hava kadar hafiftir ve yıldırımla çatırdar.
gear-armour#0353.flat: Fashioned from the cut tails of the now extinct Venti, these nearly immaterial boots are light as air and crackle with lightning.

gear-armour#0354.src: "A little belief, and just a little spirit, can go a long way."
gear-armour#0354.dst: "Biraz inanç ve birazcık ruh, insanı çok uzaklara götürebilir."
gear-armour#0354.flat: "A little belief, and just a little spirit, can go a long way."

gear-armour#0355.src: These common leather boots were once owned by a barbarian with no magical prowess. Instead of enchanting it, he coated the soles in corrupted shards to punish those who opposed him.
gear-armour#0355.dst: Bu sıradan deri çizmeler bir zamanlar hiçbir büyü yeteneği olmayan bir barbara aitti. Onları büyülemek yerine, karşısına çıkanları cezalandırmak için tabanlarını yozlaşmış kırıklarla kapladı.
gear-armour#0355.flat: These common leather boots were once owned by a barbarian with no magical prowess. Instead of enchanting it, he coated the soles in corrupted shards to punish those who opposed him.

gear-armour#0356.src: Are your heart, soul, and mind one? The ones who love are the most vulnerable. The ones who persist are the most detached. The ones who forget are the most naive. Only when you remove these impurities from your body could you reach the end.
gear-armour#0356.dst: Kalbin, ruhun ve aklın bir mi? Sevenler en savunmasız olanlardır. Direnenler en kopuk olanlardır. Unutanlar en saf olanlardır. Ancak bu kirleri bedeninden attığında sona ulaşabilirsin.
gear-armour#0356.flat: Are your heart, soul, and mind one? The ones who love are the most vulnerable. The ones who persist are the most detached. The ones who forget are the most naive. Only when you remove these impurities from your body could you reach the end.

gear-armour#0357.src: Sheer strength exudes from these Orcish relics, simple sandals ill-fitting to humans or Villagers. Enchanted with power and rage rather than magic, the strength that is provided when they are worn is unparalleled.
gear-armour#0357.dst: Bu Ork kalıntılarından saf güç yayılır; insanlara ya da Köylülere hiç uymayan basit sandaletlerdir. Büyüyle değil, güç ve öfkeyle büyülenmişlerdir; giyildiklerinde verdikleri güç eşsizdir.
gear-armour#0357.flat: Sheer strength exudes from these Orcish relics, simple sandals ill-fitting to humans or Villagers. Enchanted with power and rage rather than magic, the strength that is provided when they are worn is unparalleled.

gear-armour#0358.src: The depths of the seas, where the waves flow fierce and fast and wash away the agonies of the world.
gear-armour#0358.dst: Dalgaların sert ve hızlı aktığı, dünyanın acılarını silip götürdüğü denizlerin derinlikleri.
gear-armour#0358.flat: The depths of the seas, where the waves flow fierce and fast and wash away the agonies of the world.

gear-armour#0359.dst: "Bu yeleği bitirmek için biraz daha örümcek ipeği lazım!" -Lacrona, {p} Terzisi, Nivla örümcekleri tarafından yenmiş halde bulundu
gear-armour#0359.flat: "I just need a little more spider silk to finish this vest!" -Lacrona, {p} Tailor, found eaten by Nivla spiders
gear-armour#0359._raw: "I just need a little more spider silk to finish this vest!" -Lacrona, Detlas Tailor, found eaten by Nivla spiders

gear-armour#0360.dst: Kazağın önüne "Bu kazak varken Craftmas kötü geçer mi? KAR-şı çıkarım!" yazısı örülmüş.
gear-armour#0360.flat: The sweater has the quote "SNOW way Craftmas can be bad in this sweater" knitted onto the front.

gear-armour#0361.src: Orders, cannonfire, calls for surrender-the wind carries all. To ride the winds is to harness the lifeblood of battle, infiltrating up the veins of command with mere token resistance.
gear-armour#0361.dst: Emirler, top atışları, teslim çağrıları; rüzgâr hepsini taşır. Rüzgârlara binmek, savaşın can damarını dizginlemek ve komuta damarlarına göstermelik bir dirençle sızmaktır.
gear-armour#0361.flat: Orders, cannonfire, calls for surrender-the wind carries all. To ride the winds is to harness the lifeblood of battle, infiltrating up the veins of command with mere token resistance.

gear-armour#0362.src: These pure, snow-white leggings are rumored to have been crafted by the legendary ice mage Theorick. The people of {p} view them as cursed, seeking to destroy them in a bid to stop the endless winter surrounding them.
gear-armour#0362.dst: Bu saf, kar beyazı tozlukların efsanevi buz büyücüsü Theorick tarafından yapıldığı söylenir. {p} halkı onları lanetli sayar ve etraflarını saran bitmek bilmeyen kışı durdurmak için yok etmeye çalışır.
gear-armour#0362.flat: These pure, snow-white leggings are rumored to have been crafted by the legendary ice mage Theorick. The people of {p} view them as cursed, seeking to destroy them in a bid to stop the endless winter surrounding them.
gear-armour#0362._raw: These pure, snow-white leggings are rumored to have been crafted by the legendary ice mage Theorick. The people of Nesaak view them as cursed, seeking to destroy them in a bid to stop the endless winter surrounding them.

gear-armour#0363.src: Despite the valley being overtaken by anomalous forces, the toughest flora has managed to avoid extinction. Their coiling vines and roots remind you that even in the most dire of situations, you will never go quietly.
gear-armour#0363.dst: Vadiyi anormal güçler ele geçirmiş olsa da en dayanıklı bitkiler yok olmaktan kurtulmayı başardı. Kıvrılan sarmaşıkları ve kökleri, en çaresiz durumlarda bile asla sessizce gitmeyeceğini sana hatırlatır.
gear-armour#0363.flat: Despite the valley being overtaken by anomalous forces, the toughest flora has managed to avoid extinction. Their coiling vines and roots remind you that even in the most dire of situations, you will never go quietly.

gear-armour#0364.src: For some, the psychological impact of the undead incursions becomes too much to bear. They leave their lives behind hoping to find solace, only to return as an undead themselves.It's pulling towards something.
gear-armour#0364.dst: Bazıları için ölümsüz akınlarının ruhsal yükü taşınamayacak kadar ağır gelir. Teselli bulma umuduyla hayatlarını geride bırakırlar, ama yalnızca kendileri de bir ölümsüz olarak geri dönerler.Bir şeye doğru çekiyor.
gear-armour#0364.flat: For some, the psychological impact of the undead incursions becomes too much to bear. They leave their lives behind hoping to find solace, only to return as an undead themselves.It's pulling towards something.

gear-armour#0365.src: Every stride leaves a footstep of violet, trailing your path. The flower buds peek out of the ground as if nervous, and after a moment's hesitation, burgeon -- blooming hysteria into the hearts of man.
gear-armour#0365.dst: Her adım yolunda mor bir iz bırakır. Çiçek tomurcukları sanki tedirginmiş gibi topraktan başını uzatır ve bir anlık tereddütten sonra filizlenir -- insanların kalbinde çılgınlık açarak.
gear-armour#0365.flat: Every stride leaves a footstep of violet, trailing your path. The flower buds peek out of the ground as if nervous, and after a moment's hesitation, burgeon -- blooming hysteria into the hearts of man.

gear-armour#0366.src: Complex lenses such as the ones in this plating are specially designed to grant secondary visual guidance, offering rapid peripheral and otherwise situational awareness alongside the wider visual scope. A standard in certainty, always at least providing worst-case countermeasures in the densest fog of war.
gear-armour#0366.dst: Bu zırhtakiler gibi karmaşık mercekler, ikincil görsel rehberlik sağlamak için özel olarak tasarlanmıştır; geniş görüş alanının yanı sıra hızlı çevresel görüş ve durum farkındalığı sunar. Kesinlikte bir standarttır; savaşın en yoğun sisinde bile en azından en kötü duruma karşı önlem sağlar.
gear-armour#0366.flat: Complex lenses such as the ones in this plating are specially designed to grant secondary visual guidance, offering rapid peripheral and otherwise situational awareness alongside the wider visual scope. A standard in certainty, always at least providing worst-case countermeasures in the densest fog of war.

gear-armour#0367.src: The ultimate folly of a heavyweight war machine. Too big to dodge and too easy to hit, with this core being the conclusion of this conflict. Still undeniably bulky, but just lightweight enough to allow rapid movement through short energy bursts. A luxury to most mechs of this scale.
gear-armour#0367.dst: Ağır bir savaş makinesinin nihai budalalığı. Kaçamayacak kadar büyük, vurulması fazla kolay; bu çekirdek de bu çatışmanın sonucudur. Hâlâ inkâr edilemez derecede hantal, ama kısa enerji patlamalarıyla hızlı hareket etmeye yetecek kadar hafif. Bu boyuttaki çoğu robot için bir lüks.
gear-armour#0367.flat: The ultimate folly of a heavyweight war machine. Too big to dodge and too easy to hit, with this core being the conclusion of this conflict. Still undeniably bulky, but just lightweight enough to allow rapid movement through short energy bursts. A luxury to most mechs of this scale.

gear-armour#0368.src: Some mechs, particularly those built with long range in mind, are equipped with gyroscopic subcores like these to give more consistent aim and spatial control in active warfare. Fragile machinery compared to other systems, but a worthwhile trade compared to being staggered or raining fire on allies from being glanced by artillery.
gear-armour#0368.dst: Bazı robotlar, özellikle uzun menzil düşünülerek yapılanlar, aktif savaşta daha tutarlı nişan ve uzamsal kontrol sağlamak için bunun gibi jiroskopik alt çekirdeklerle donatılır. Diğer sistemlere göre kırılgan bir mekanizmadır, ama topçu ateşi sıyırınca sendelemek ya da müttefiklerin üstüne ateş yağdırmaktansa değer bir takastır.
gear-armour#0368.flat: Some mechs, particularly those built with long range in mind, are equipped with gyroscopic subcores like these to give more consistent aim and spatial control in active warfare. Fragile machinery compared to other systems, but a worthwhile trade compared to being staggered or raining fire on allies from being glanced by artillery.

gear-armour#0369.src: Reinforced leg plating for heavyweight machines. Built to last- and then some. Namely to hold such massive things up readily, but also to keep as pressing of a threat as long as possible- threatening destruction only under critical core damage, rather than being knocked down by a well placed hit.
gear-armour#0369.dst: Ağır makineler için güçlendirilmiş bacak kaplaması. Dayanmak için yapıldı, hem de fazlasıyla. Asıl amacı böylesine devasa şeyleri rahatça ayakta tutmak, ama aynı zamanda tehdidi mümkün olduğunca uzun süre canlı tutmak; iyi yerleştirilmiş bir darbeyle devrilmek yerine yalnızca kritik çekirdek hasarında yıkım tehdidi oluşturmak.
gear-armour#0369.flat: Reinforced leg plating for heavyweight machines. Built to last- and then some. Namely to hold such massive things up readily, but also to keep as pressing of a threat as long as possible- threatening destruction only under critical core damage, rather than being knocked down by a well placed hit.

gear-armour#0370.src: Hidden amongst the foundations of the Expanse are anomalous fragments wrapped in an otherworldly power. While unsettling to the touch, the strength they impart is too tempting to ignore.
gear-armour#0370.dst: Expanse'in temellerinin arasında, öteki dünyaya ait bir güçle sarılmış anormal parçalar saklıdır. Dokunması tedirgin edici olsa da verdikleri güç görmezden gelinemeyecek kadar caziptir.
gear-armour#0370.flat: Hidden amongst the foundations of the Expanse are anomalous fragments wrapped in an otherworldly power. While unsettling to the touch, the strength they impart is too tempting to ignore.

gear-armour#0371.src: This turquoise mask burns into your skin, binding flesh and stone. The flames are a constant reminder of the balance between creation and destruction, and that the fire which sustains can also consume.
gear-armour#0371.dst: Bu turkuaz maske tenini yakar, eti ve taşı birbirine bağlar. Alevler, yaratım ile yıkım arasındaki dengeyi ve can veren ateşin yakıp yok edebileceğini sürekli hatırlatır.
gear-armour#0371.flat: This turquoise mask burns into your skin, binding flesh and stone. The flames are a constant reminder of the balance between creation and destruction, and that the fire which sustains can also consume.

gear-armour#2474.src: The universe loves you. It loves you so much that its heart bleeds for you, into your hands and leaking between your fingers. You can't hold onto it; can't say back the words that mean so much to you, for there is nobody there to hear them.
gear-armour#2474.dst: Evren seni seviyor. Seni öyle çok seviyor ki kalbi senin için kanıyor; ellerine akıyor, parmaklarının arasından sızıyor. Onu tutamazsın; senin için o kadar anlamlı olan sözleri karşılık olarak söyleyemezsin, çünkü onları duyacak kimse yok.
gear-armour#2474.flat: The universe loves you. It loves you so much that its heart bleeds for you, into your hands and leaking between your fingers. You can't hold onto it; can't say back the words that mean so much to you, for there is nobody there to hear them.

gear-armour#2475.src: "What's yours is mine, and what's mine is yours, so emptying those bloated coffers is of little loss to you, no?"
gear-armour#2475.dst: "Seninki benimdir, benimki de senin; o şişkin kasaları boşaltmak sana pek bir şey kaybettirmez, değil mi?"
gear-armour#2475.flat: "What's yours is mine, and what's mine is yours, so emptying those bloated coffers is of little loss to you, no?"
